children: 就在二十年前，许多学者还认为第三世界国家会重演西方的国家形成经历。如今已大体被放弃的“政治发展”观念，曾集中体现了这样一种构想：存在一条标准轨道，国家可以沿着它驶向充分参与和有效性的终点——而参与和有效性的样板，当然就是某个现有的西方国家。政治发展论者的信心被以下几件事粉碎：中国、日本、韩国、古巴等明确的替代模式的出现；既有发展方案可悲地未能预见第三世界国家的实际经历；第三世界领导人和学者对西方学术建议之居高临下的抵制；大国在对待第三世界国家时转向现实政治；以及西方学者彼此之间关于如何正确解读过去经验的争论（见 Evans and Stephens 1989）。与“现代化”“教育发展”以及其他用意良好却模糊了问题的口号一道，“政治发展”正迅速从分析词汇表中消失。

As recently as twenty years ago, many scholars thought that Third World states would recapitulate the Western experience of state formation. The idea of "political development," now largely abandoned, epitomized the conception of a standard track along which states could roll toward the terminus of full participation and effectiveness - the model of participation and effectiveness being, of course, one or another of the existing Western states. The confidence of political developmentalists shattered with the emergence of clear alternative models such as China, Japan, Korea, and Cuba, the embarrassing failure of existing development schemes to anticipate the actual experiences of Third World states, resistance by Third World leaders and scholars to the condescension of Western academic advice, turns to
Realpolitik

in the great powers' treatment of Third World states, and disputes among Western scholars themselves as to the proper reading of past experience (see Evans and Stephens 1989). Along with "modernization," "educational development," and other well-meaning but obfuscatory slogans, political development is fast disappearing from the analytical lexicon.
尽管旧的分析如今看来错得离谱，但设想非西方国家会经历某些与西方同类国家相同的经历、并最终看起来更像它们，并不算完全愚蠢。作为西方各强国不久前的殖民地，大多数新独立国家在起步时就拥有按西方模式勾勒出来的正式组织，并纳入了殖民机构的重要部分。受过西方教育的国家领导人自觉地设法建立受西方启发的行政机构、议会、政党、军队和公共服务。

As misconceived as the old analyses now seem, it was not utterly stupid to suppose that non-Western states would undergo some of the same experiences as their Western counterparts and end up looking much more like them. As recent colonies of various Western powers, a majority of newly independent states began their careers with formal organizations traced on Western lines and incorporating significant parts of the colonial apparatus. Western-educated state leaders sought self-consciously to install administrations, parliaments, parties, armies, and public services of Western inspiration.

更有甚者，他们还公开这样说：第三世界领导人宣称要使自己的国家现代化，在政治上发展它们。西方主要大国积极协助他们，提供专家、模式、培训项目和资金。只要日本还在舔舐第二次世界大战失败的创伤、中国还深陷内部斗争，就没有其他模式明显可供选择。可选项似乎从苏联式社会主义一直排到美国式资本主义，两边之外没有可行的国家形成道路。整个谱系都重演了欧美经验的某种版本。1960年，卢西恩·派伊（Lucian Pye）在谈到东南亚时宣称：
东南亚的主导主题，是这些新国家的领导人努力从其过渡社会中创造出现代国民国家
。这些领导人已使其人民承担起建立代议制政府机构、发展更具生产力的经济生活方式的任务。尽管对这些目标的热情并不缺乏，但要估计它们实现的机会却很困难，因为在东南亚正在演化中的政治系统和社会系统，其轮廓至今仍难以辨认。失败的可能性很大，领导人和公民都可能为自我怀疑所困扰。朝向更为威权化做法的趋势已经广泛存在：例如，军队正开始扮演原本保留给民主政治家的角色。（Pye 1960: 65-6）

What is more, they said so; Third World leaders declared that they would modernize their countries, develop them politically. Major Western powers assisted them actively, lending experts, models, training programs, and funds. So long as Japan was reeling from its losses in World War II and China was consumed with its internal struggles, no other models were obviously available. The choices seemed to run from Soviet-type socialism to American-style capitalism, with no viable paths of state formation beyond either extreme. The entire range recapitulated one version or another of European-American experience. Speaking of Southeast Asia in 1960, Lucian Pye declared that:

the dominant theme of Southeast Asia is the effort of the leaders of these new countries to create modern nation-states out of their transitional societies. These leaders have committed their peoples to the task of establishing representative institutions of government and developing more productive modes of economic life. Although enthusiasm for these goals has not been lacking, it is difficult to estimate their chances of being realized, for it is still hard to discern even the outlines of the political and social systems that are evolving in Southeast Asia. The possibility of failure is great, and leaders and citizens can be troubled with self-doubts. Already the tendency toward more authoritarian practices is widespread: for example, armies are coming to play roles that were originally reserved for democratic politicians. (Pye 1960: 65-6)

请注意这种措辞：它说的是在一个所知甚少、且对这一事业颇为凶险的局势中，去建造某种特征已为人熟知的东西。要建造的那个“东西”，是按西方设计打造的有效民族国家。诚然，派伊看到了东南亚可能出现某种相当不同的东西，甚至东南亚领导人可能力求某种不同的东西。大多数新独立国家的领导人实际上都宣称，他们要寻求第三条道路，至少带有模糊的社会主义色彩，位于美国的斯库拉与俄国的卡律布狄斯之间。但界定选择范围的，是现有的西方国家。政治发展论者以不同程度的教条主义和洞察力所说的，恰恰就是这一点。

Note the language: it speaks of constructing something whose characteristics are well known in a situation that is poorly understood, and menacing to the enterprise. The "something" to construct was an effective national state on a Western design. To be sure, Pye saw the possibility that something quite different might emerge in Southeast Asia, even that Southeast Asian leaders might press for something different. Most leaders of newly independent states actually declared that they sought a third way, at least vaguely socialist, somewhere between the American Scylla and the Russian Charybdis. But the existing Western states defined the range of choice. With varying degrees of dogmatism and perspicacity, political developmentalists said exactly that.

即便是西里尔·布莱克（Cyril Black）这样在历史上有细致研究的分析者，也提出了以政治发展诸相继阶段为特征的模型。布莱克区分了不下七条不同的具体现代化路径，分别以英国、美国、比利时、乌拉圭、俄国、阿尔及利亚和利比里亚为例，顺序即如此（Black 1966: 90-4）。但他主张，他所有这些各不相同的实例都经历了四个阶段：现代性的挑战、现代化领导层的巩固、经济与社会的转型，然后是社会的整合。在他的分析中，以往的历史确实影响到任一特定社会如何面对这些挑战。但最终，他所考察的所有欧洲案例都按同样的顺序跨过前三个门槛，达到某种类似社会整合的状态。

Even historically sophisticated analysts such as Cyril Black promulgated models featuring successive stages of political development. Black distinguished no fewer than seven different concrete paths of modernization, those illustrated by the United Kingdom, the United States, Belgium, Uruguay, Russia, Algeria, and Liberia, in that order (Black 1966: 90-4). But he argued that all his varied instances passed through four stages: a challenge of modernity, a consolidation of modernizing leadership, an economic and social transformation, and then the integration of society. Previous history, in his analysis, affected exactly how any particular society faced these challenges. But eventually all the European cases he examined arrived at something like societal integration after crossing the three previous thresholds in the same order.

这套看似合理的集体推理有一个重大缺陷。它假定：存在单一标准的国家形成过程；每个国家或多或少各自经历同样的内部过程；西方经验是该过程的范例；当代西方国家大体上已到达该过程的终点；问题只在于一场规模极大的社会工程。把这些假定放到建设“现代”非洲、亚洲、拉丁美洲或中东国家的实践中去检验，立刻引起了怀疑。主要权力持有者抵制或扭曲既有政府组织的改造，官员利用国家权力谋取自己的目的，政党变成族性集团或庇护—依附链条的工具，国家主导的企业垮台，魅力型领袖压制西方式的选举政治，第三世界国家的许多其他特征也对西方模式提出了挑战。

The plausible collective reasoning had a great flaw. It supposed that a single standard process of state formation existed, that each state passed through the same internal process more or less separately, that Western experience exemplified the process, that contemporary Western states had generally reached the end of the process, and that the problem was one of social engineering on a very large scale. The effort to put those suppositions to the test in the construction of "modern" African, Asian, Latin American, or Middle Eastern states immediately raised doubts. Major powerholders resisted or distorted the transformation of existing governmental organization, officials used state power for their own ends, political parties became vehicles of ethnic blocs or patron-client chains, state-led enterprises collapsed, charismatic leaders suppressed Western-style electoral politics, and many more features of Third World states challenged the Western models.
西方模式？事实上，关于“政治发展”的标准论述也误解了它们表面上所依据的西方经验。总体而言，它们把西方经验呈现为一个自觉解决问题的过程，经历了若干标准的、内部生成的阶段，最终产生成熟而稳定的国家。对奥甘斯基（A. F. K. Organski，1965: 7）来说，这些阶段是：
原始统一的政治；
工业化的政治；
国民福利的政治；
富足的政治。

Western models? In fact, the standard treatments of "political development" also misconstrued the Western experience on which they ostensibly drew. On the whole, they presented it as a conscious problem-solving process that passed through a series of standard internally-generated stages and finally produced mature, stable states. For A.F.K. Organski (1965: 7), the stages were:
the politics of primitive unification;
the politics of industrialization;
the politics of national welfare;
the politics of abundance.
奥甘斯基这一颇具代表性的图式把大量第三世界经验压缩进它的第一阶段，但随后勾画出一条明显通向现有欧洲世界及其扩展部分的道路。

Organski's characteristic scheme compressed a great deal of Third World experience into its first stage, but then delineated a path that clearly led toward the existing European world and its extensions.

同样，众多政治分析者认为，向现代性的过渡是从一种均衡状态——传统社会之类——走向另一种更优越的现代均衡。按这一论证思路，两者之间是快速社会变迁的动荡。由于20世纪的社会变迁比以往快得多，新国家承受的压力大于其欧洲前辈。因此第三世界国家冒有对外冲突与国内冲突同时发生的风险，而两者又互相刺激（见 Wilkenfeld 1973）。然而它们最终会学会遏制冲突，实现现代类型的稳定政府。至少，大量关于政治发展的文献是这样教导的。

Similarly, a great many political analysts thought that the transition to modernity passed from one condition of equilibrium - traditional society, or something of the sort - to another, superior, modern equilibrium. In between, according to this line of argument, lay the turbulence of rapid social change. Because social change was occurring much more rapidly in the twentieth century than before, new states were experiencing greater stresses than their European predecessors. Thus Third World states ran the risk of simultaneous foreign and domestic conflict, each stimulating the other (see Wilkenfeld 1973). Eventually, however, they would learn to contain conflict and achieve stable government of a modern kind. So, at least, taught much of the literature on political development.

自1960年代以来，对西方经验的更清晰解读已使那些假定的不足变得显而易见。本书贪婪地借用了此后积累起来的知识储备，并把这一积累重新投资于对西方国家历史的重释。在前几章中，我们已看到，欧洲国家形成的轨迹因强制与资本的地理分布、主要权力持有者的组织以及来自其他国家的压力而差异何等之大。我们考察了统治者、其他权力持有者与普通人之间一长串不平等斗争如何创造出具体的国家制度和对国家的要求。我们注意到，欧洲国家最终在组织上的趋同，在多大程度上是它们之间竞争的结果，这种竞争既发生在欧洲内部，也发生在世界其他地区。我们目睹了战争以及备战对国家结构其他特征的深刻影响。所有这些观察导向这样的结论——含糊但有用：第三世界的国家形成应当呈现出鲜明差异，而强制与资本之间关系的变化应当为判断这种差异的性质提供线索。

Since the 1960s, a clearer reading of Western experience has made the inadequacy of those suppositions obvious. This book has borrowed greedily from the subsequent fund of knowledge, and has reinvested the accumulation in a reinterpretation of Western states' history. In earlier chapters, we have seen how widely the trajectories of European state formation varied as a function of the geography of coercion and capital, the organization of major powerholders, and pressure from other states. We have examined how a long series of unequal struggles among rulers, other powerholders, and ordinary people created specific state institutions and claims on the state. We have noticed how much the eventual organizational convergence of European states resulted from competition among them, both within Europe and in the rest of the world. We have witnessed the profound impact of war, and preparation for war, on other features of state structure. All these observations lead to the conclusions - vague but helpful - that Third World state formation should be distinctively different, and that the changed relations between coercion and capital should provide clues as to the nature of that difference.

当代经历应当在哪些方面不同于欧洲的过去？在资本密集型、强制密集型与资本化强制这三条国家形成道路分叉数百年之后，欧洲国家在几个世纪前开始趋同；战争与相互影响造成了这种趋同。然而，尽管共同的殖民地经历把某些共同属性加给了许多第三世界国家，它们之间至今并未发生大规模的趋同。恰恰相反。任何研究欧洲国家形成的人都不难注意到当今第三世界国家的多样性。任何把庞大古老的中国与微小崭新的瓦努阿图、把富裕的新加坡与赤贫的乍得都包括在内的类别，都带有这种多样性；我们不大可能成功地就如此异质的一组经历作出概括。而且，无论怎样发挥想象，第三世界国家并非都是“新”国家。中国和日本属于世界上延续存在最古老的国家之列，暹罗／泰国已有数百年历史，大多数拉丁美洲国家在拿破仑战争期间获得正式独立。它们与1945年以来形成的国家站在一起，主要共同点在于它们新近获得了欧洲的斗争所创造并界定的国家体系中的正式成员资格。

In what ways should contemporary experience differ from that of the European past? After centuries of divergences among capital-intensive, coercion-intensive, and capitalized-coercion paths of state formation, European states began to converge a few centuries ago; war and mutual influence caused the convergence. Although shared colonial experience imposed common properties on many Third World states, however, no great homogenization has so far occurred among them. On the contrary. Any student of European state formation can hardly help noticing the variety of today's Third World states. Variety marks any category that includes both immense, ancient China and tiny, brand-new Vanuatu, both wealthy Singapore and dirt-poor Chad; we are unlikely to generalize successfully about such a heterogeneous set of experiences. Not all the states of the Third World, furthermore, are "new" states, by any stretch of the imagination. China and Japan stand among the world's oldest continuously existing states, Siam/Thailand is centuries old, and most Latin American states acquired formal. independence during the Napoleonic Wars. They stand with states formed since 1945 chiefly in their recent acquisition of full membership in the state system that European struggles created and defined.

然而，再仔细看看：第三世界国家的异质性究竟在哪里？与其说在它们的组织结构，不如说在公民与国家之间的关系。事实上，过去一个世纪左右，世界各国正式的组织特征已急剧趋同；采用这种或那种西方模式，几乎已成为获得国家体系先前成员承认的前提条件。目前160多个得到承认的国家，其组织范围比1500年200多个欧洲国家的组织范围狭窄得多，后者包括城邦、城市帝国、联邦、王国、领土帝国等等。除了相对集权的联邦和王权已相当弱化的王国之外，那些曾经繁多的政治形式几乎都已消失。1500年以后，大规模战争的压力与大规模媾和的谈判共同把所有欧洲国家推向一种新的组织形式：民族国家。在欧洲盛行的从“内部”国家形成向“外部”国家形成的漂移一直延续到我们这个时代，并把一种共同的定义强加给世界上极其不同地区的国家。狭义上的当代国家结构彼此相似，都有法院、立法机构、中央官僚机构、地方行政机构、常备军、专门化的警察力量以及一整套公共服务；甚至社会主义经济、资本主义经济与混合经济之间的差异，也无法压倒这些共同属性。

Look more closely, however: exactly what is heterogeneous about Third World states? Not so much their organizational structures as relations between citizens and states. Formal organizational characteristics of the world's states have, in fact, converged dramatically over the last century or so; the adoption of one Western model or another has become a virtual prerequisite for recognition by prior members of the state system. The present 160-odd recognized states cover a much narrower organizational range than the 200-odd European states of 1500, which included city-states, city-empires, federations, kingdoms, territorial empires, and more. Except for relatively centralized federations and quite attenuated kingdoms, those once-abundant political forms have all but disappeared. After 1500, both the pressures of large-scale warmaking and the negotiations of large-scale peacemaking drove all European states toward a new organizational form: the national state. The drift from "internal" to "external" state formation which prevailed in Europe has continued into our own time, and imposed a common definition on states in very diverse parts of the world. Contemporary state structures, in the narrow sense, resemble each other in featuring courts, legislatures, central bureaucracies, field administrations, standing armies, specialized police forces, and a panoply of public services; even the differences among socialist, capitalist, and mixed economies fail to override these common properties.

然而，这些形式上相似的组织，其运作方式却全然不同。差异既在于表面上无从区分的法院、立法机构、官厅或学校各自的内部运作，也在于政府机构与公民之间的关系。在欧洲的经验中，国家采取的形式在对外战争的急迫要求与臣民人口的要求之间起中介作用；在某种程度上，每个国家的组织都适应了当地的社会与经济条件。当既有民族国家以自己的形象塑造新来者时，地方性适应反而发生在公民与国家之间的关系中。如今，强制密集型、资本密集型与资本化强制这几种情境之间的差异对国家正式结构的影响远小于从前，但对公民与国家之间关系的影响却更大。就此而言，当代世界仍然极其多样。

Yet such formally similar organizations do not work at all in the same manner. The differences lie in both the internal operation of superficially indistinguishable courts, legislatures, bureaux, or schools and the relations between governmental agencies and citizens. In the European experience, states took forms that mediated between the exigencies of external war and the claims of the subject population; to some degree, each state's organization adapted to local social and economic conditions. As existing national states sculptured newcomers in their own image, local adaptation occurred instead in relations between citizens and states. These days the difference between coercion-intensive, capital-intensive, and capitalized-coercion settings affects the formal structure of states much less than it used to, but affects relations between citizens and states even more. In that regard, the contemporary world remains extremely diverse.

第三世界存在吗？诚然，拉丁美洲、中东和东亚的国家，无论就内部组织还是就其在世界国家体系中的位置而言，都差异极大。之所以从这样一个粗糙的复合类别入手，理由在于：世界低收入地区的国家长期忍受欧洲及其扩展部分的正式控制，普遍采用了欧洲或美国的正式组织形式，发现自己被卷入它们几乎无法控制的超级大国争斗，并构成一个不稳定却反复出现的同盟储备库，供国家体系的新来者结盟之用（Ayoob 1989）。国家体系在向非欧洲世界扩展时并未简单地保持不变；来自亚洲、非洲和拉丁美洲的数十个独立国家的进入，以某种方式改变了这一体系，而与先前欧洲经验的比较有助于阐明这种方式。

Does the Third World exist? Certainly Latin American, Middle Eastern, and East Asian states differ greatly with respect both to internal organization and to position within the world system of states. The justification for beginning with such a crude, composite category rests on the fact that states in lower-income regions of the world have long endured under the formal control of Europe and its extensions, have commonly adopted European or American models of formal organization, find themselves caught in superpower struggles over which they can exert little control, and constitute an uneasy but recurrent pool for alliances with newcomers to the state system (Ayoob 1989). In extending to the non-European world, the state system did not simply remain the same; the entrance of scores of independent states from Asia, Africa, and Latin America transformed the system in ways that a comparison with previous European experience can illuminate.
因此，把当代第三世界的经历与已有长期记录可查的民族国家的经历相比较，我们仍有所得。至少，这种比较有助于我们迈出两个有用的步骤：（1）在浪费时间把那些已证明有缺陷的国家形成观念应用于当代经历之前，先将其抛弃；（2）使我们更敏锐地辨别，在世界上较贫困地区目前正发生的国家形成、转型与变形过程中，哪些是独特的，哪些是熟悉的。

We still have something to gain, then, from the comparison of contemporary Third World experience with that of national states for which a long record is already available. At a minimum, that comparison will help us take two useful steps: (1) to discard ideas about state formation that have already proven themselves faulty before wasting time applying them to contemporary experience; (2) to sharpen our sense of what is distinctive, and what familiar, in the processes of state formation, transformation, and deformation now occurring in the poorer parts of the world.
反思欧洲经验，我们可能预期在当代世界看到什么？鉴于欧洲内部国家形成的多样性，我们没有理由预期单一的变化轨迹。但我们有理由从欧洲外推如下几点：

Reflecting on European experience, what might we expect to find happening in the contemporary world? Given the diversity of state formation within Europe, we have no reason to anticipate a single trajectory of change. But we might reasonably extrapolate from Europe to:
强制与资本的相对分布对国家形成路径的显著影响；
• significant influence of the relative distributions of coercion and capital on the paths of state formation;
在存在和不存在显著城市集群的情况下，变化方向截然不同；
• distinctively different directions of change in the presence and absence of significant clusters of cities;
战争与备战对国家结构的创造与改变的强烈影响；
• strong effects of war and preparation for war on the creation and alteration of state structure;
（a）财政结构和（b）武器与军事人员的来源在上述影响的传导中起中介作用；
• mediation of those effects through (a) fiscal structure and (b) the sources of arms and military personnel;
通过建立中央官僚机构、日益依赖信贷和税收来购买军事手段、并就这些手段与臣民人口讨价还价而使国家权力文官化；

• civilianization of state power through the creation of central bureaucracies, increasing reliance on credit and taxation for the purchase of military means, and bargaining with the subject population over those means;
国家组织形式从“内部”决定转向“外部”决定的趋势持续下去。
• continuation of the trend from "internal" to "external" determination of the organizational forms of states.
诚然，在一个与大多数欧洲国家成形时所处的世界如此不同的世界里，这些仍不过是定向性的假设。但相较于那种旧观念——第三世界国家会以某种方式重演最有效能的西方民族国家的理想化经历——它们已大有改进。

In a world so different from that in which most European states took shape, to be sure, these remain no more than orienting hypotheses. Yet they improve considerably on the old notion that Third World states would somehow recapitulate the idealized experience of the most effective Western national states.

zh: 第二次世界大战的影响与遗产
en: THE IMPACT AND HERITAGE OF WORLD WAR II

children: 那么，是什么使当代世界的国家形成区别于过去的同类过程？尽管20世纪的战争造成的死亡比以往任何时候都多，战争的性质却已发生显著变化。1945年以来，往往有大国协助和纵容的大规模内战在世界上比在欧洲的经历中常见得多。核武器和其他技术威胁加重了一场大战可能造成的代价。一个几乎全球规模的两极国家体系的形成，影响了大多数国家的政治与军事前景。依据“国家间关系的数目随国家数目的算术增长而几何增长”这一原理，相互连接但名义上独立的国家的大量增殖，使国家体系变得极为复杂。

What, then, distinguishes state formation in the contemporary world from its counterparts in the past? Although twentieth-century war takes a deadlier toll than ever, war has changed significantly in character. Large-scale civil wars, often aided and abetted by great powers, have become much more common in the world since 1945 than they were in European experience. The threat of nuclear arms and other technical menaces has compounded the likely costs of a major war. The formation of a bipolar state system on a nearly global scale affected the politics, and the military prospects, of most states. On the principle that the number of relations among states increases geometrically as the number of states increases arithmetically, the sheer proliferation of connected but nominally independent states greatly complicated the state system.
第二次世界大战改变了国家体系以及体系内的各个国家。作为交战国公民、作为战区居民，或两者兼是，世界大多数人都感受到了这场战争的影响。这场战争在杀戮、财产破坏和人口流离方面都打破了所有纪录。美国在广岛和长崎投下原子弹，从而把历史上第一批有可能在数日之内毁灭全人类的武器引入战争。

World War II transformed the state system and the states within it. As citizens of belligerent states, as inhabitants of battle zones, or both, most of the world's people felt the war's impact. The war broke all records for killing, for destruction of property, and for displacement of populations. By dropping atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, the United States introduced into warfare the first weapons in history with the potential to annihilate all humanity in a few days.

我们可以合理地把第二次世界大战的起点定在1938年（当时日本与俄国开始交战，而德国兼并了波兰并肢解了捷克斯洛伐克），或定在1939年（当时德国入侵波兰，随后入侵捷克斯洛伐克其余部分）。无论取哪一种，1945年日本投降都标志着这场战争相对整齐的结束。战斗中死亡约一千五百万人，另有约二千五百万人因战争的直接后果而死，这使第二次世界大战成为人类历史上破坏性远居首位的一场交战。至少有上千人战斗死亡的国家包括保加利亚、英国、澳大利亚、加拿大、埃塞俄比亚、波兰、美国、苏联、比利时、巴西、中国、南斯拉夫、荷兰、罗马尼亚、意大利、新西兰、法国、南非、希腊、挪威、蒙古、日本、德国、匈牙利和芬兰（Small and Singer 1982: 91）。这场战争使日本、中国的重要部分以及欧洲的大部分地区化为废墟。

We can reasonably place the start of World War II in 1938 (when Japan and Russia began to fight while Germany annexed Poland and dismembered Czechoslovakia) or in 1939 (when Germany invaded Poland and then the rest of Czechoslovakia). In either case, Japan's surrender in 1945 marks a relatively neat end to the war. Perhaps fifteen million deaths in battle and another twentyfive million as a direct result of war made World War II by far the most destructive belligerency in human history. Powers sustaining at least a thousand battle deaths included Bulgaria, the United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, Ethiopia, Poland, USA, USSR, Belgium, Brazil, China, Yugoslavia, the Netherlands, Rumania, Italy, New Zealand, France, South Africa, Greece, Norway, Mongolia, Japan, Germany, Hungary, and Finland (Small and Singer 1982: 91). The war left Japan, important parts of China, and much of Europe devastated.

战争结束时，有两个国家高踞于所有其他国家之上：美国和苏联。美国在第二次世界大战中损失相对较轻（战斗死亡40.8万人，相比之下德国为350万人），但在经历了一场使人衰弱的萧条之后动员起了巨大的工业能力。美国这个在战争中肌肉更加发达的工业巨兽占据了世界国家体系中的主导地位，这并不令人惊讶。苏联的崛起是更大的谜团。苏联在战争中经受了可怕的匮乏（战斗死亡750万人，总死亡人数或许达2000万，丧失60%的工业能力），但在此过程中建立起令人敬畏的国家组织（Rice 1988）。无疑，这种增强了的国家能力，加上苏联控制向其他东欧国家的扩展，有助于解释两极世界的另一极。几乎立刻，先前的盟友就转而彼此敌对，从而四个世纪以来第一次阻断了一次全面的和平解决方案。其结果是，日本和德国这样的战败国长期忍受战胜国的军事占领，只是缓慢地重新获得国家体系的成员资格。事实上，战胜国与战败国只是零碎地了结这场战争：通过占领、临时国际协议、部分条约和事实上的承认。战争的复杂性与规模，加上其两极结局，超出了国际体系的能力，使它无法产生自1503年以来终结历次欧洲重大战争的那种全面解决方案。

As the war ended, two states towered over all the rest: the USA and the USSR. The United States had suffered relatively light losses (408 thousand battle deaths as compared, for instance, with Germany's 3.5 million) during World War II but had mobilized enormous industrial capacity after a debilitating depression. It is not surprising that the United States, an industrial colossus grown even more muscular in war, seized a dominant position in the world system of states. The rise of the Soviet Union is the greater puzzle. The USSR had endured terrible privations in the war (7.5 million battle deaths, perhaps 20 million in total fatalities, and 60 percent of industrial capacity lost) but had built up a formidable state organization in the process (Rice 1988). No doubt that enhanced state capacity, and the extension of Soviet control to other eastern European states, helps account for the other pole of the bipolar world. Almost immediately the former allies turned to an enmity that blocked a general peace settlement for the first time in four centuries. As a result, losers of the war such as Japan and Germany long endured the victors' military occupation, and only slowly regained membership in the state system. In fact, the victors and the vanquished only settled the war piecemeal, in occupations, provisional international agreements, partial treaties, and
de facto

recognitions. The war's complexity and scale, plus its bipolar outcome, overwhelmed the capacity of the international system to produce the sort of general settlement that had ended major European wars since 1503.

战后的国家形成过程之所以区别于其前身，尤其在于西方殖民地被整体转变为正式独立的国家。形势有利于欧洲撤退：苏联在欧洲殖民的主要地区没有殖民地，美国也几乎没有，而欧洲列强正忙于从战争破坏中恢复。各附属地以令人目眩的速度要求并获得作为自治实体的承认。仅1960年一年，比属刚果（今扎伊尔）、贝宁、喀麦隆、中非共和国、乍得、刚果、塞浦路斯、加蓬、科特迪瓦、马达加斯加、马里、尼日尔、尼日利亚、塞内加尔、索马里、多哥和上沃尔特（今布基纳法索）在获得独立国家承认后不久都加入了联合国。

The postwar process of state formation distinguished itself from its predecessors especially in the wholesale transformation of Western colonies into formally independent states. The situation favored European withdrawal: the USSR had no colonies in the major areas of European colonization, and the United States had few, while the European powers were preoccupied with recovery from the ravages of war. At a dizzying pace, dependencies demanded and won recognition as autonomous entities. In 1960 alone the Belgian Congo (now Zaïre), Benin, Cameroon, the Central African Republic, Chad, the Congo, Cyprus, Gabon, Côte d'Ivoire, Madagascar, Mali, Niger, Nigeria, Senegal, Somalia, Togo and Upper Volta (now Burkina Faso) all joined the United Nations shortly after receiving recognition as independent states.

与此同时，苏联、尤其是美国，把其军事基地、军事援助计划和情报设施的网络扩展到全世界（Eden 1988）。例如在东亚，美国以自身军事力量取代了已去军事化的日本的军事力量，改组并掌管韩国军队，并在中国国民党军队于大陆战败以及撤退去控制台湾的过程中向其提供补贴（Cumings 1988, Dower 1988, Levine 1988）。此外，1945年至1984年间，美国向韩国投入130亿美元的军事—经济援助，又向台湾投入56亿美元，相比之下，整个非洲共获得68.9亿美元，整个拉丁美洲获得148亿美元（Cumings 1984: 24）。

At the same time the Soviet Union and, especially, the United States, extended the networks of their military bases, military assistance programs, and intelligence facilities throughout the world (Eden 1988). In East Asia, for example, the United States substituted its own military power for that of a demilitarized Japan, reorganized and ran the South Korean military, and subsidized China's KMT forces both in their losing mainland battles and in their retreat to control of Taiwan (Cumings 1988, Dower 1988, Levine 1988). Between 1945 and 1984, furthermore, the United States pumped $13 billion of military-economic aid into South Korea and another $5.6 billion into Taiwan, as compared with a total for all Africa of $6.89 billion and all Latin America of $14.8 billion (Cumings 1984: 24).

大体上，欧洲列强放弃其宗主统治时所经历的阵痛小得惊人。除了阿尔及利亚的独立斗争和印度支那冲突的早期阶段之外，最激烈的战斗发生在以下地方：有一个以上集团声称有权统治新国家的地方；被解放人口中的一部分要求建立自己国家的地方；以及各权利要求者之间的分裂招致大国广泛干预的地方。中国、巴勒斯坦、马来亚、肯尼亚、塞浦路斯、亚丁、婆罗洲、朝鲜、越南、菲律宾、卢旺达、安哥拉和莫桑比克提供了显而易见的例子。联合国承担起登记和管理新成员进入国际国家体系的工作。

For the most part, European powers relinquished their overlordships with remarkably little travail. With the exception of the Algerian struggle for independence and the early stages of the Indochinese conflicts, the bitterest battles occurred where more than one group claimed the right to rule the new state, where a segment of the liberated population demanded its own state, and where the division among the claimants incited extensive great power intervention; China, Palestine, Malaya, Kenya, Cyprus, Aden, Borneo, Korea, Vietnam, the Philippines, Ruanda, Angola, and Mozambique provide the obvious examples. The United Nations undertook to register and manage the entry of new members into the international system of states.

因此，对于1945年以来的时期，我们可以在任何一个时点把联合国会员国作为世界国家体系的近似值。这一近似并不完善：瑞士、韩国、朝鲜、台湾、摩纳哥、图瓦卢以及其他少数单位的行为像国家，却不属于联合国；而白俄罗斯和乌克兰两个共和国（在最近民族主义骚动之前，完全是苏联全资拥有的附属机构）之属于联合国，是对苏联在第二次世界大战结束时行使的强力的让步。但总体而言，该组织包括了世界上的重要国家，并在新国家于国际事务中获得一定程度的自主时把它们吸收进来。

For the period since 1945, we can therefore take the membership of the United Nations at any point in time as an approximation of the world's state system. The approximation is imperfect: Switzerland, South Korea, North Korea, Taiwan, Monaco, Tuvalu, and a few other units behave like states but do not belong, while the Byelorussian and Ukrainian republics (until the recent stirrings of nationalism, wholly owned subsidiaries of the USSR) belong as concessions to the power the Soviet Union wielded at the end of World War II. But in general, the organization includes the world's important states, and has absorbed new states as they have achieved a measure of autonomy in international affairs.

图7.1展示了自1945年该组织创立至1988年联合国会员国的地理分布。情况显而易见：联合国起步时，绝大多数成员国来自欧洲和美洲——即旧的欧洲国家体系及其扩展部分，减去第二次世界大战的主要战败国，加上少数西方之外的重要国家。随着欧洲和平安排逐步落实、加勒比国家开始获得独立和国际承认，来自欧洲和美洲的国家数目温和增长。但1955年以后，亚洲国家加入联合国的速度超过西方国家。1960年以后，非洲国家在新成员中占据主导。

Figure 7.1 presents the geographic distribution of UN members from the organization's founding in 1945 to 1988. The story is obvious: the UN started out with a large majority of states from Europe and the Americas - the old European state system and its extensions, minus the major losers of World War II and plus a few important states outside of the West. The numbers of states from Europe and the Americas increased modestly as European peace settlements fell into place and as Caribbean states began acquiring independence and international recognition. But after 1955 Asian states entered the UN at a faster rate than those of the West. From 1960 onward African states dominated the new entries.

平均而言，新加入者走的是强制密集型、通往国家地位的道路。撤离的殖民列强留下的积累资本很少，却把军队遗赠给继承国，这些军队取自并模仿它们先前为维持自身地方行政而建立的镇压力量。装备和训练相对良好的武装力量随后专门用于控制平民人口和打击叛乱者，而非用于国家间战争。一旦欧洲人拆解了自己的政府机构，武装力量、教会和西方公司往往就是在该国领土上运作的最有效组织。此外，武装力量还有一些独特特征：其高级军衔迅速被先前在殖民军队中担任下级职位的人填满。它们往往延续殖民列强确立的招募模式，过多地从某一个语言、宗教和／或区域人口中招募，因而成为尖锐族性竞争的工具或场所。例如，直到1966年，尼日利亚军队一直避免表现出地区或族性上的明显分裂。但随着1966年1月的军事政变，裂痕开始显现。7月，一个来自北方的军官联盟领导了另一次政变，并迅速采取行动，把伊博人（他们尤其来自尼日利亚东部区）逐出军队和权力。不久（1967年5月），东部以比亚夫拉之名公开叛乱，非洲最血腥的内战之一由此开始（Luckham 1971: 17-82）。

The new entrants, on the average, were following coercion-intensive paths to statehood. The departing colonial powers left little accumulated capital behind them, but bequeathed to their successor states military forces drawn from and modeled on the repressive forces they had previously established to maintain their own local administrations. Relatively well equipped and trained armed forces then specialized in control of civilian populations and in combat against insurgents rather than interstate war. Once Europeans dismantled their own governmental apparatus, the armed forces, the churches, and Western corporations were frequently the most effective organizations operating in the state's territory. The armed forces, furthermore, had some distinctive characteristics: their senior ranks filled rapidly with men who had previously occupied subordinate positions in colonial armies. Often, continuing a pattern of recruitment established by colonial powers, they drew disproportionately on one linguistic, religious, and/or regional population, and therefore became the instrument or the site of sharp ethnic rivalries. Up to 1966, for example, the Nigerian army held itself aloof from manifest division by region or ethnicity. But with the military coup d'etat of January 1966, fissures began to show. In July, a coalition of officers from the north led another coup, and acted quickly to expel Ibos (who came especially from Nigeria's Eastern Region) from the army and power. Soon (May 1967) the east, as Biafra, broke into open rebellion, and one of Africa's bloodiest civil wars began (Luckham 1971: 17-82).

children: 除非魅力型国家领袖刻意加以约束，第三世界的军队通常抵制文官控制。高级军官常常觉得，并且公开表示，他们比单纯的政客更清楚国家的命运需要什么，以及如何在实现那一命运的过程中维持秩序。此外，只要他们的国家通过在国际市场上出售商品来产生岁入、在海外购买武器并接受大国的军事援助，武装力量就能享有这种绝缘状态：不必依赖文官政府所授权的征税和征兵。

Except where charismatic national leaders deliberately held them in check, Third World armies commonly resisted civilian control. Senior officers frequently felt, and said, that they knew better than mere politicians what the country's destiny required, and how to maintain order on the way to fulfilling that destiny. To the extent that their states generated revenues by selling commodities on the international market, bought arms overseas, and received military aid from great powers, furthermore, the armed forces enjoyed insulation from reliance on taxation and conscription authorized by civilian governments.

然而，出口国的军队能在多大程度上保持自主，取决于它们与统治阶级主要成员结成的（或未能结成的）联盟，也取决于出口计划的成效。在玻利维亚，锡业巨头靠出口收入过着阔绰生活，在国内建立的牢固联系很少，这种自我封闭使他们易受军方夺取国家权力和锡收入的打击（Gallo 1985）。在台湾，这个蒋介石治下的典型警察国家，工业出口计划的巨大成功最终使军队不再专注于入侵中国大陆的准备工作，削弱了他们对政策和政府日常运作的控制，并使强大的文职官员环绕其周围（Amsden 1985）。

How far the military of exporting countries were able to maintain autonomy, however, depended on the alliances they formed (or failed to form) with major elements of the ruling class, and on the success of the export program. In Bolivia, the encapsulation of tin tycoons, who lived handsomely on export income and established few strong ties within the country, made them vulnerable to military seizure of state power and of tin revenues (Gallo 1985). In Taiwan, a quintessential police state under JiangJie-Shi (Chiang Kai-Shek), the great success of the industrial export program eventually diverted the military from their preparations to invade the Chinese mainland, reduced their control over policy and day-to-day governmental operations, and surrounded them with powerful civilian officials (Amsden 1985).

此外，1945年以后战争的性质发生了显著变化。尽管西方列强之间的战争几乎消失，就全世界而言，致命的战斗实际上变得更频繁了。表7.1显示了1893年以来的趋势，数字以千人为单位，指某一年内至少造成一千人战斗死亡的各场战争中的战斗死亡数。各时期的总数波动剧烈。但这些数字清楚地显示出若干趋势：死亡集中于全面战争时期；“体系外”战争随着越来越多国家进入国际国家体系而趋稳或减少；作为战斗死亡来源的内战，其突出程度不规则地上升。新内战造成的战斗死亡从世纪之交的每年约一万人上升到1937年至1947年间的每年十万人，随后三十年间在十万人上下波动。

What is more, the character of war changed significantly after 1945. Despite the near-disappearance of wars among Western powers, lethal combat actually became more frequent in the world as a whole. Table 7.1 shows the trend since 1893, expressed as thousands of battle deaths in wars involving at least a thousand battle deaths in a given year. The totals fluctuate sharply from one period to the next. Yet the figures show several trends clearly: the concentration of deaths in the periods of general war, the stabilization or decline of "extrasystemic" wars as more and more states entered the international state system, the irregularly increasing prominence of civil wars as the origin of deaths in battle. The number of new civil wars rose from about ten thousand battle deaths per year at the century's start to a hundred thousand deaths per year between 1937 and 1947, then fluctuated around the hundred-thousand mark over the next three decades.

进入20世纪，战斗死亡数越来越低估战争造成的破坏。对平民聚落的轰炸和炮击杀死了越来越多的非战斗人员，更不用说他们的生计手段。在战争期间和战后，国家开始前所未有地驱赶甚至驱逐人口。而蓄意屠杀整个群体的企图——种族灭绝与政治灭绝——已从它一度显得罕见的、骇人听闻的越轨行为，转变为一种标准的统治技术。1945年至1987年间，国家代理人对平民的蓄意大规模杀戮，在全世界的死亡人数可能在700万至1600万之间，超过在国际战争和内战的直接交战中死亡的人数（Harff and Gurr 1988）。

With the twentieth century, battle deaths underestimated more and more the damage done by war. The bombing and shelling of civilian settlements destroyed increasing numbers of non-combatants, not to mention their means of livelihood. During and after wars, states began to displace or even expel populations as never before. And the deliberate attempt to kill entire populations - genocide and politicide - has turned from the rare, appalling aberration that it once seemed to a standard technique of government. Between 1945 and 1987, deliberate mass killing of civilians by agents of states probably caused from 7 million to 16 million deaths throughout the world, more than died in the direct engagements of international and civil wars (Harff and Gurr 1988).

children: 1945年以后发生的内战，有时源于各阶级之间对国家权力的总体争夺。更常见的是，它们源于特定的宗教、语言和领土群体对自治或对控制某个现有国家的要求。在这个有限的意义上，随着整个世界逐渐稳定为一幅由稳定的、彼此排斥的国家领土构成的完整地图，民族主义在战争中变得更加突出；被排除在外的民族的权力持有者眼看着自己的机会正在溜走。

Civil wars that occurred after 1945 sometimes arose from general struggles among classes for state power. More often they sprang from the claims of particular religious, linguistic, and territorial groups for autonomy or for control of an existing state. In this limited sense, nationalism has become more salient in wars as the world as a whole has settled into a complete map of stable, mutually-exclusive state territories; the powerholders of excluded nationalities see their chances slipping away from them.

与此同时，大国越来越多地干预内战，通过确保同情己方的派别获胜，来谋取控制国家者的结盟与合作。1970年代，安哥拉、布隆迪、柬埔寨、危地马拉、伊朗、约旦、黎巴嫩、尼加拉瓜、巴基斯坦、菲律宾、罗得西亚和斯里兰卡开始了大规模内战；其中只有一场（危地马拉）外部列强没有以实质方式介入（Dunér 1985: 140）。1980年结束时，菲律宾、安哥拉、危地马拉、阿富汗、萨尔瓦多、尼加拉瓜、柬埔寨、莫桑比克和秘鲁战火正炽。在大多数这些案例中，美国、苏联或南非至少稍有卷入。尽管与先前几十年相比，1980年代提供了一些喘息，但两伊战争的破坏性（战斗死亡或许达一百万）以及其他斗争延续进入这个十年，使得1991年下一个时段统计完成时不大可能确立一种下降趋势。

At the same time, great powers have intervened increasingly in civil wars, seeking alignment and cooperation of those who control the state by assuring that the sympathetic faction wins. During the 1970s, substantial civil wars began in Angola, Burundi, Cambodia, Guatemala, Iran, Jordan, Lebanon, Nicaragua, Pakistan, the Philippines, Rhodesia, and Sri Lanka; in only one of them (Guatemala) did outside powers refrain from intervening in a substantial way (Dunér 1985: 140). When 1980 ended, wars were raging in the Philippines, Angola, Guatemala, Afghanistan, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Cambodia, Mozambique, and Peru. In most of these cases, the United States, the Soviet Union, or South Africa was at least marginally involved. Although the 1980s offered some respite by comparison with previous decades, the destructiveness of the Iran-Iraq war (perhaps a million battle deaths) and the continuation of other struggles into the decade makes it unlikely that the completion of the next interval in 1991 will establish a downward trend.

可获得的武器预示着新的破坏水平，核武器的扩散则以灭绝威胁着整个世界。目前，美国、俄罗斯、英国、法国、中国和印度肯定拥有自己的核武器。除此之外，西德、以色列、巴西、阿根廷、巴基斯坦和日本正在处理钚，这至少使它们距拥有核军事能力仅一步之遥。其他表面上非核、未签署1968年《核不扩散条约》——因而仍是核能力的活跃候选者——的国家包括西班牙、以色列、智利、古巴和南非。因此，世界上得到承认的国家中约有10%，包括其最强大的国家，或部署核武器，或保留这样做的权利。战争不会随着时间推移而变得更温和。（A. J. P. 泰勒在其本来颇为闲谈式的《战争如何结束》一书结尾，对核威胁作了一个令人不寒而栗的提醒：“不过，别担心。第三次世界大战将是最后一次”：Taylor 1985: 118。）与此同时，非核战争不断增多。

Available weaponry promised new levels of destructiveness, as the proliferation of nuclear arms threatened the whole world with extinction. At the moment, the USA, Russia, the United Kingdom, France, China, and India definitely have their own nuclear weapons. In addition to them, West Germany, Israel, Brazil, Argentina, Pakistan, and Japan are processing plutonium, which brings them at least within striking distance of nuclear military capacity. The other ostensibly non-nuclear states that did not sign the 1968 nuclear nonproliferation treaty - and therefore remain active candidates for nuclear capacity - include Spain, Israel, Chile, Cuba, and South Africa. About 10 percent of the world's recognized states, including its greatest powers, then, either deploy nuclear arms or retain the right to do so. War will not become more benign as time goes on. (A. J. P. Taylor ends his otherwise chatty
How Wars End
with a chilling reminder of the nuclear threat: "However, do not worry. The Third World War will be the last": Taylor 1985: 118.) In the meantime, non-nuclear wars proliferate.

战争的持续上升与国际边界的固化结合在一起。除少数重要例外，跨越边界的军事征服已经结束，国家已不再为争夺有争议的领土而互相作战，边防力量已把努力方向从抵御直接进攻转向控制渗透。军队（就此而言还有海军和空军）越来越多地集中于镇压平民人口、打击叛乱者和夺取权力。其结果是，政府随着边界变得更加安全而变得更加不稳定。由于控制国家者把整个群体划为自己的敌人，战争以巨大的速率制造难民（按通常估计，1970年前后世界难民数为800万，1980年前后为1050万：Zolberg 1981: 21）。

The continued rise of war couples with a fixation of international boundaries. With a few significant exceptions, military conquest across borders has ended, states have ceased fighting each other over disputed territory, and border forces have shifted their efforts from defense against direct attack toward control of infiltration. Armies (and, for that matter, navies and air forces) concentrate increasingly on repression of civilian populations, combat of insurgents, and seizures of power. As a consequence, governments become more unstable as their borders become more secure. Because those who control states define whole populations as their enemies, wars generate refugees at a huge rate (conventional estimates set the number of refugees in the world at 8 million toward 1970 and 10.5 million toward 1980: Zolberg 1981: 21).

如果说第二次世界大战的结束开启了世界战争与和平的新纪元，那么1960年代则带来了该纪元内迄今最大的转变。1960年代初，非殖民化和新国家进入国际体系加速，内战的破坏性及其在所有战争中所占份额大为增加，军事权力在拉丁美洲、亚洲和中东得到巩固，争夺非洲国家控制权的军事斗争迅速增多。古巴导弹危机确认了美国与苏联大致的战略对等，也稳定了它们对各自边界周围相互排斥的势力范围的主张。最重要的是，军人越来越多地卷入争夺国家权力的斗争。因此，让我们集中考察军事权力在第三世界国家中的地位。

If the end of World War II began a new era for worldwide war and peace, the 1960s brought the largest transition so far within that era. During the early 1960s, decolonization and entry of new states into the international system accelerated, civil wars greatly increased in destructiveness and in their share of all wars, military power consolidated in Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East, and military struggles for control of African states multiplied rapidly. The Cuban missile crisis confirmed the rough strategic equality of the United States and Soviet Union, as well as stabilizing their claims to mutually exclusive zones of influence around their own frontiers. Above all else, military men became increasingly involved in struggles for state power. Let us therefore focus on the place of military power in Third World states.

尽管关于第三世界军队的写作一向比政治发展或经济发展的分析更具试探性、意见分歧也更大，西方分析者在那里也普遍采用一种隐含的“成熟”政体模型。他们设想，在这种政体中，无可挑剔地专业化的军人占据重要但明显从属的位置；这一模型直接来自大多数欧洲国家在近几个世纪国家形成过程中的经验。分析者的任务于是是勾画出那条将能或可能从印度尼西亚或刚果军队的现状通向适合稳定民主的状态的道路。这一任务还带来进一步的任务：解释对那条受青睐道路的偏离——尤其是许多殖民地领土在获得正式独立时蒙受表面上民主、代议制政府之福，却迅速转向军人统治这一令人困惑的方式。

Although writing on the Third World's military was always more tentative and divided than analyses of political or economic development, there too Western analysts commonly adopted an implicit model of the "mature" polity. In such a polity, they supposed, impeccably professional military men occupied a significant but clearly subordinate place; the model followed directly from the experience of most European states during the last few centuries of state formation. The analyst's job was then to chart the path that would or could lead from the present condition of the military in Indonesia or the Congo to the condition appropriate for stable democracy. That job entailed the further task of accounting for deviations from the favored path - in particular, the puzzling way in which many colonial territories gained formal independence blessed with ostensibly democratic and representative governments, yet quickly moved to military rule.
大多数分析者与爱德华·希尔斯（Edward Shils）同样认为：“当议会民主政体动摇时，军人统治是若干可行且显然稳定的替代方案之一。这些政体一直难以跨越的既有障碍和新生障碍，比这些国家军人精英的抱负更具决定性，尽管后者并非不重要”（Shils in Johnson 1962: 9）。于是政治发展与军事发展合并成同一个问题。如今，这两个观念都已在怀疑、矛盾与绝望中消散。

Most analysts thought, with Edward Shils, that "Military rule is one of the several practicable and apparently stable alternatives when parliamentary, democratic regimes falter. The inherited and the newly engendered obstacles over which these regimes have been stumbling are more determinative than the aspirations of the military elites of these states, although the latter are not unimportant" (Shils in Johnson 1962: 9). Thus political development and military development merged into the same problem. Both ideas have now dissolved in skepticism, contradiction, and despair.

在非洲和南亚这样的第三世界地区，研究西方历史的人不禁会注意到一些明显的不衔接：一方面是外观西化的20世纪军队的存在，另一方面是令人想起文艺复兴时代的军人政治的盛行；一方面是代议制政府的机构，另一方面是任意动用国家权力对付公民；一方面是看似常规的官僚机构的设置，另一方面是广泛利用政府组织谋取个人利益。这些不衔接在刚刚摆脱殖民统治的国家比在第三世界其他地方更为明显。与欧洲历史表面上的教导相反，大政府的成长、任意统治与军事化如今似乎正携手并进。

In Third World regions such as Africa and South Asia, a student of Western history cannot help noticing apparent disjunctions between the existence of Western-looking twentieth-century armies, on the one hand, and the prevalence of military politics reminiscent of the Renaissance, between the apparatus of representative government and the arbitrary use of state power against citizens, between the installation of apparently conventional bureaucracies and the widespread use of governmental organization for individual gain. These disjunctions are more visible in states that have recently escaped from colonial rule than in the rest of the Third World. Contrary to the apparent teaching of European history, the growth of big government, arbitrary rule, and militarization now seem to be going hand in hand.

三十年前，塞缪尔·亨廷顿主张，文官对军队的控制通过两种不同的过程实现，一种不稳定，一种稳定。不稳定的过程是一场权力斗争，其中某个非军人集团使军队服从于某个政府机构、一部宪法或某个特定社会阶级；亨廷顿给它起了一个古怪的名称：“主观”控制。在他看来，“客观”控制来自军队专业化的最大化，以及对政治之外一个独立军事领域的承认。“从历史上看，”亨廷顿说，“对客观控制的要求来自军界，对主观控制的要求则来自形形色色急于在军事事务中使自身权力最大化的非军人集团”（Huntington 1957: 84-5）。悖谬的是，那些企图通过干预军队专业化来增加自身权力的非军人，反而促成了军方夺取权力。按这一论证，亲军的意识形态、较低的军人政治权力和较高的军队专业化促进文官控制，而反军的意识形态、较高的军人政治权力和较低的军队专业化则促进军人控制。

Thirty years ago, Samuel Huntington argued that civilian control over the military occurred through two different processes, one unstable and one stable. The unstable process was a power struggle in which one civilian group or another subordinated the military to a governmental institution, a constitution, or a particular social class; Huntington gave it the odd name of "subjective" control. "Objective" control, in his eyes, resulted from maximizing military professionalism and recognizing an independent military sphere outside of politics. "Historically," said Huntington, "the demand for objective control has come from the military profession, the demand for subjective control from the multifarious civilian groups anxious to maximize their power in military affairs" (Huntington 1957: 84-5). Paradoxically, civilians who sought to increase their own power by interfering in military professionalization thereby promoted military seizure of power. A pro-military ideology, low military political power, and high military professionalism, by this argument, promote civilian control, while anti-military ideology, high military political power and low military professionalism promote military control.

把军人政治权力塞进对军人控制的解释，给论证引入了一种循环成分，但我们可以通过检验亨廷顿认为会促进政治权力的那些因素来打破这个循环：军方人员与其他强大集团之间的私人联系、直接置于军官团控制之下的资源、军官团与非军人权力结构在层级上的相互渗透、军官团及其领袖的声望与受拥戴程度。因此我们可以预期，如果一支军官团主要从统治阶级之外招募，可支配的非军事资源很少，担任的非军事职务很少，民众追随者也很少，那么它的政治权力就相对较小。

The insertion of military political power into the explanation of military control introduces an element of circularity into the argument, but we can break the circle by checking the factors Huntington considers to promote political power: personal affiliation of the military with other powerful groups, resources placed directly under the control of the officer corps, hierarchical interpenetration of the officer corps with civilian power structures, prestige and popularity of the officer corps and its leaders. Thus we would expect an officer corps to have relatively little political power if it recruited chiefly from outside the ruling classes, had few non-military resources at its disposal, held few non-military offices, and had little popular following.
亨廷顿写作的时代，人们对第三世界军队的专业化和文官控制的加强抱有乐观情绪。在亨廷顿五年之后，西班牙—墨西哥作家维克托·阿尔瓦（Victor Alba）以其对拉丁美洲军人干政的论断延续了这种乐观基调：

Huntington wrote in a time of optimism about the professionalization of Third World armies and the strengthening of civilian control. Five years after Huntington, the Spanish-Mexican writer Victor Alba continued the note of optimism in his declaration that Latin American militarism:
已到达其历史上的倒数第二阶段。在最后阶段，它将消失。那个时代可能已为期不远。受立法与外交行动可能性增加以及国际组织日益关注的鼓舞，拉丁美洲的强大势力已把消除军人干政当作其主要关切。（Alba in Johnson 1962: 165-6）

has arrived at the penultimate phase in its history. In its final stage it will disappear. That epoch may be near. Encouraged by the increased possibilities of legislative and diplomatic action and the growing concern of international organizations, powerful elements in Latin America have made the obliteration of militarism their major preoccupation. (Alba in Johnson 1962: 165-6)
然而，千年盛世迟迟未至。尽管巴西和阿根廷对军队进行了大幅遏制，智利皮诺切特政权终结，巴拉圭阿尔弗雷多·斯特罗斯纳的个人化统治垮台，拉丁美洲和加勒比24个较大国家中仍有9个给予其武装力量广泛的权力与自主。此外，在幕后，南美洲的军队仍是一支不可小觑的政治力量。

The millennium, however, has dragged its feet. Despite dramatic containment of the military in Brazil and Argentina, the end of Chile's Pinochet regime, and the collapse of Alfredo Stroessner's personalistic rule in Paraguay, nine of the 24 larger Latin American and Caribbean states still accord extensive power and autonomy to their armed forces. Behind the scenes, furthermore, the militaries of South America still constitute a political force to reckon with.

若把亨廷顿的分析当作三十年前作出的预测，它表明：就世界上不同地区出现亲军意识形态、军人政治权力下降、军队专业化增强而言，文官控制本应变得更有效。反过来说，如果军人控制实际上变得更加普遍，那么我们应当发现反军意识形态得势、军人政治权力上升、军队专业化下降。这些预测中有些东西看来是错的：过去三十年中世界各国的军人控制增加了，但尽管按亨廷顿的标准军人政治权力确实扩大了，反军意识形态却似乎并未变得更加流行，而军队专业化几乎可以肯定有所增长。为弄清发生了什么，我们应当考察军事化国家在世界国家体系中的位置。

Treated as a prediction made thirty years ago, Huntington's analysis indicates that in so far as pro-military ideologies have arisen, military political power has declined, and military professionalism has increased in different parts of the world, civilian control should have become more effective. If, on the other hand, military control has actually become more widespread, then we should find that anti-military ideologies have gained, military political power has risen, and military professionalism has declined. Something in those predictions looks wrong: military control has increased in the world's states over the last thirty years, but while military political power, by Huntington's standards, has surely expanded, anti-military ideology does not seem to have become more prevalent, and military professionalism has almost certainly grown. To clarify what has happened, we should look at the place of militarizing states in the world's system of states.

children: 从16世纪开始、直到不久前才结束，西方国家通过殖民、商业联系的扩展和直接谈判，把世界其余部分纳入自己的体系。最近加入者大多通过非殖民化以独立行为体的身份加入体系，因此到来时已带有按西方模式设计的行政结构、财政体系和武装力量；前殖民地的头衔、额外津贴和制服反映了那些国家的影响。然而，复制一张组织编制表并不能保证新国家会像旧国家那样行事。这一点在第三世界军队的行为中表现得最为清楚。穷国的军队在许多方面与富国的军队相似。但总体而言，它们远为直接和频繁地干预国内政治生活，对公民权利造成的后果也明显更具破坏性。为什么会这样？

Starting in the sixteenth century and ending only very recently, Western states incorporated the rest of the world into their system through colonization, elaboration of commercial ties, and direct negotiation. Most recent entrants joined the system as independent actors through decolonization, and therefore arrived with administrative structures, fiscal systems, and armed forces designed on Western lines; titles, perquisites, and uniforms of the former colonies reflect those national influences. Yet reproducing a table of organization provides no guarantee that the new state will behave like the old. Nowhere is that clearer than in the behavior of the Third World's military. The armies of poor countries resemble those of rich countries in many regards. But on the whole they intervene in domestic political life far more directly and frequently, and with more obviously damaging consequences for rights of citizens. Why should that be?

回想欧洲国家形成的中心悖论：追求战争与军事能力，在作为一种副产品创造出民族国家之后，却导致了政府与国内政治的文官化。我认为这之所以发生，有五个主要原因：因为建立和维持军事力量的努力促使国家代理人建立由文官充任的庞大抽取机构，而这些抽取机构反过来容纳并约束了军事力量；因为国家代理人与控制有效战争所需资源的非军人集团讨价还价，并在讨价还价中赋予这些非军人集团可要求国家兑现的权利，从而进一步约束了军队；因为战时国家能力的扩张，使那些在战争中未遭受重大损失的国家在战争结束时保有了扩大的能力，而这些国家的代理人利用这一形势承担新的活动，或继续他们在紧急状态下开始的活动；因为战争努力的参与者、包括军事人员，获得了对国家的权利要求，这些要求因镇压或相互同意而在战时被推迟，但在复员时被重新提出；最后因为战时的借贷导致国债大幅增加，国债又催生了服务性官僚机构，并鼓励国家对国民经济进行更多干预。

Think back to the central paradox of European state formation: that the pursuit of war and military capacity, after having created national states as a sort of by-product, led to a civilianization of government and domestic politics. That happened, I have argued, for five main reasons: because the effort to build and sustain military forces led agents of states to build bulky extractive apparatuses staffed by civilians, and those extractive apparatuses came to contain and constrain the military forces; because agents of states bargained with civilian groups that controlled the resources required for effective warmaking, and in bargaining gave the civilian groups enforceable claims on the state that further constrained the military; because the expansion of state capacity in wartime gave those states that had not suffered great losses in war expanded capacity at the ends of wars, and agents of those states took advantage of the situation by taking on new activities, or continuing activities they had started as emergency measures; because participants in the war effort, including military personnel, acquired claims on the state that they deferred during the war in response to repression or mutual consent but which they reactivated at demobilization; and finally because wartime borrowing led to great increases in national debts, which in turn generated service bureaucracies and encouraged greater state intervention in national economies.

在一部漫画体的欧洲史中，这个故事会以四个画面呈现。第一幅画面中，国王身披甲胄、手持长剑，亲自招募并指挥自己的陆军和海军，而这些军队在为他效劳时保持着对他本人的忠诚。第二幅画中，国王穿着华美的军服，却与一名雇佣兵队长（condottiere）订约为他雇用雇佣兵作战。第三幅画中，国王穿着一身完全不适合打仗的华丽礼服，与将军们和陆军大臣们商议，而这些人在一个复杂的、文官主导的结构中找到了自己的位置。最后一幕，我们看到一位国王（他如今可能已化身为总统或首相）身着西装，不仅与自己的僚属谈判，也与主要非军人利益集团及全体居民依正式程序产生的代表谈判。（这四幅画面带有人们熟悉的副题：家产制、经纪、国家化、专业化。）诚然，这个漫画版的文官化以不同程度的逼真性描述了不同的国家经历；它更贴合德国经验，而不是荷兰或俄国经验。但作为对欧洲国家文官化的图式化概述，它是够用的。

In a cartoon history of Europe, the story would appear in four panels. In the first panel, the king wears armor and carries a sword, recruiting and commanding his own army and navy, which maintain personal loyalty to his service. In the second, the king bears glorified military garb, but contracts with a
condottiere

for the hire of mercenaries to fight his battles. In the third panel, the king, fitted out in a grand costume utterly unsuitable for fighting wars, consults with generals and ministers of war who find their places in a complex, civilian-dominated structure. In the last scene we see a king (who may now be a president or prime minister in disguise) sporting a business suit and negotiating not only with his staff but also with duly constituted representatives of major civilian interests and of the population at large. (The four panels bear the familiar subtitles Patrimonialism, Brokerage, Nationalization, and Specialization.) To be sure, the comic-book version of civilianization describes different national experiences with varying verisimilitude; it fits German experience better than Dutch or Russian. But it will do as a schematic summary of civilianization in European states.

欧洲国家形成的另一个一般特征值得我们注意。与其他国家的关系在任何一个特定国家的形成中都起了重要作用，哪怕仅仅因为战争与战争安排显著影响了该国的结构和边界。尽管如此，最先形成的民族国家的组织结构，主要是在准统治者与他们试图统治的人民之间的斗争中成形的。然而，随着欧洲国家体系固化，整批整批的国家开始决定战争的结果，因而决定从战争中产生的国家的组织结构。于是拿破仑的军队在征服的同时彻底重组各国，维也纳会议重绘地图，纳入一个此前并不存在的尼德兰王国，以及面目大改的普鲁士、撒丁、巴伐利亚、巴登和奥地利。欧洲从相对“内部”的国家形成过程转向相对“外部”的过程。

Another general feature of European state formation deserves our attention. Relations with other states played a significant part in the formation of any particular state, if only because wars and war settlements significantly affected the state's structure and boundaries. Nevertheless, the organizational structures of the first national states to form took shape mainly as a consequence of struggles between would-be rulers and the people they were trying to rule. As the European state system solidified, however, whole sets of states began to decide the outcomes of wars, and therefore the organizational structures of states that emerged from the wars. Thus Napoleon's forces drastically reorganized states as they conquered, and the Congress of Vienna redrew the map to include a previously nonexistent. kingdom of the Netherlands plus a greatly-reshaped Prussia, Sardinia, Bavaria, Baden, and Austria. Europe moved from relatively "internal" to relatively "external" processes of state formation.

这种朝向外部的转向延续到20世纪。只要瞥一眼20世纪的国家形成过程，就会发现它们具有三重外部性：许多新民族国家是作为其他国家、尤其是欧洲国家的殖民地占有地而形成的；许多国家在另一个远为强大的强权的影响下建立其统治机构；而各国协调机制（concerts of nations）——联合国是其最新体现——已批准并在某种程度上维持了它们作为国际国家体系独立成员的存在。一个后果是20世纪国家边界的灵活性下降。除非作为由众多国家谈判达成的全面和平安排的一部分，征服导致任何国家边界重大重划的可能性都越来越小。如今危地马拉声称拥有整个伯利兹，委内瑞拉声称拥有圭亚那的一部分，但美洲其他国家在这两种情况下都不会容忍领土掠夺。尽管战争——游击战或其他战争——仍相当频繁地发生，许多国家并不面临严重的外部军事威胁。这意味着许多军队几乎没有打仗的前景。它们专门从事内部控制。

That shift toward the external continued into the twentieth century. Only a glance at twentieth-century processes of state formation reveals that they are triply external: many new national states formed as colonial possessions of other states, especially European states; many built their governing institutions under the influence of another, much greater, power; and concerts of nations - the United Nations being their latest embodiment - have ratified and to some extent sustained their existence as separate members of the international state system. One consequence is a decreasing flexibility of state boundaries in the twentieth century. Except as a part of a general peace settlement negotiated by many states, it becomes decreasingly likely that conquest will lead to a major redrawing of any state's perimeter. These days Guatemala claims all of Belize and Venezuela claims some of Guyana, but other states of the Americas will not tolerate a territorial grab in either case. Although wars, guerrilla and otherwise, continue to occur quite frequently, many states face no serious external military threat. That means many armies have little prospect of going to war. They specialize in internal control.
第三世界军队具体借鉴欧洲或美国的模式、援助和训练的程度，远远超过欧洲国家干预彼此军队形成的程度。例如在拉丁美洲，第二次世界大战以前，法国和德国训练了阿根廷、玻利维亚、巴西、智利和秘鲁的许多军官。战后，美国接过了这项任务（Nunn 1971）。这种外部干预使拉丁美洲军队相对于其潜在对手和选定的敌人获得了非凡的回旋余地。

Third World militaries have drawn specifically on European or American models, aid, and training to a far larger degree than European states intervened in the formation of each other's armies. In Latin America, for example, before World War II France and Germany trained many of the officers of Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, and Peru. After the war, the United States took over the task (Nunn 1971). This external intervention gave Latin American militaries exceptional maneuverability vis-a-vis their potential rivals and chosen enemies.
在欧洲，国家形式的外部强加并未对政体稳定产生明显影响。诚然，从奥斯曼帝国和奥匈帝国废墟上形成的大多数国家，其对稳定民主的把握不如北方邻国牢靠，人们也可以主张，德国和意大利民族国家形成的迟晚与其易受法西斯主义侵袭之间存在联系。但在北欧，芬兰、挪威和波罗的海诸共和国独立较晚，并未阻止它们建立相对持久的政体（见 Alapuro 1988）。

In Europe, the external imposition of state forms occurred without obvious impact on the stability of regimes. Most of the states formed out of the ruins of the Ottoman and Austro-Hungarian empires had, it is true, unsteadier holds on stable democracy than their northern neighbors, and one might argue a connection between late national state formation and vulnerability to fascism in Germany and Italy. But in northern Europe, the late independence of Finland, Norway, and the Baltic republics did not stop them from establishing relatively durable regimes (see Alapuro 1988).

然而，在1945年以后的世界里，外部强加与不稳定之间的关系似乎加强了。在统治者从商品出口或大国军事援助中抽取岁入的能力使他们得以绕过与臣民人口讨价还价的地方，庞大的国家大厦在缺乏公民实质性同意或支持的情况下生长起来。由于特定国家制度与人口中主要社会阶级之间缺乏牢固联系，这些国家变得更易受武力夺取权力和政府形式骤然变动的冲击。例如，在1955年已经独立的世界较贫困国家中，政府支出在国民生产总值中所占份额较高（可以说这是外部影响的一个结果）预示着此后二十年里更频繁的政体变动，正如1950年至1969年间更频繁的政体变动预示着此后十五年里更高的政府支出份额（Thomas and Meyer 1980）。这些情况为军力扩充和军方争夺权力创造了条件。

In the world since 1945, however, the relationship between external imposition and instability seems to have increased. Where the ability of rulers to draw revenues from commodity exports or from great-power military aid has allowed them to bypass bargaining with their subject populations, large state edifices have grown up in the absence of significant consent or support from citizens. Lacking strong ties between particular state institutions and major social classes within the population, those states have become more vulnerable to forcible seizures of power and abrupt changes in the form of government. Among the world's poorer states that were already independent in 1955, for example, higher shares of government expenditure in Gross National Product (arguably an outcome of external influence) predicted more frequent regime changes during the next two decades, just as more frequent regime changes between 1950 and 1969 predict higher shares of government expenditure in the subsequent fifteen years (Thomas and Meyer 1980). These circumstances invite military buildup, and military bids for power.

外部影响与政治不稳定之间的关系极可能是曲线式的，不稳定在中等和／或变动中的外部控制水平上最高。另一方面，外部影响与军人控制之间的关系则相当直接。外部影响的极端形式是军事占领；只要占领持续，占领区的政权往往得以维持。第二次世界大战与先前的大战不同，没有以全面安排告终；它在德国、奥地利、日本、朝鲜和其他地方留下的军事占领持续了许多年。战后年代，西方主要大国——其中尤以苏联和美国为甚——在海外维持着前所未有的军队数量。1987年，有29个国家在别国领土上正式驻扎军队。美国在西德有25万军队，在日本5.4万，在韩国4.3万；苏联则在东德部署38万，在阿富汗11万，在匈牙利6.5万，在捷克斯洛伐克6万。苏联在占领者中居首：

Most likely the relationship between external influence and political instability is curvilinear, with instability highest at intermediate and/or changing levels of external control. That between external influence and military control, on the other hand, is quite direct. The extreme form of external influence is military occupation; as long as it lasts, the occupied regime tends to stay in place. World War II differed from previous general wars by not ending in a general settlement; it left military occupations in Germany, Austria, Japan, Korea, and elsewhere to drag on for years. During the postwar years, the great Western powers - incomparably, the USSR and the USA - maintained unprecedented numbers of troops abroad. In 1987, 29 states officially stationed troops within some other state's territory. The USA had 250,000 troops in West Germany, 54,000 in Japan and 43,000 in South Korea, while the Soviet Union deployed 380,000 in East Germany, 110,000 in Afghanistan, 65,000 in Hungary, and 60,000 in Czechoslovakia. The Soviet Union led the occupiers:

令人意外的是越南（估计在柬埔寨有14万军队，在老挝另有5万）和古巴（在安哥拉有2.7万，另有部队分散在刚果、尼加拉瓜和也门：Sivard 1988: 12-13）。尽管主导国有时派兵阻止或逆转权力转移，但总体而言，它们的存在大大降低了政体进一步变动的几率。

The surprises are Vietnam (with an estimated 140,000 troops in Cambodia and another 50,000 in Laos) and Cuba (with 27,000 in Angola and other forces scattered in Congo, Nicaragua, and Yemen: Sivard 1988: 12-13). Although dominant states sometimes sent troops in to forestall or reverse transfers of power, on the whole their presence greatly reduced the odds for further changes of regime.

世界各国的军事投入正迅速增加。第二次世界大战后的复员之后，按人均计算，军事支出急剧上升，在第三世界尤其如此。1960年至1987年间，经通货膨胀校正，人均军事开支增加了近150%，而人均国民生产总值上升约60%（Sivard 1988: 6）。然而，在世界较富的国家，军事预算实际上从1960年约占国民生产总值的6.9%下降到1984年的约5.5%；在较穷的国家，这一百分比则从3.6%上升到5.6%；穷国现在把其微薄收入中更大的一份用于武器和军队，超过富国从其远为充裕的收入中所支出的份额。（“富国”包括澳大利亚、奥地利、比利时、保加利亚、加拿大、捷克斯洛伐克、丹麦、东德、芬兰、法国、匈牙利、冰岛、爱尔兰、以色列、意大利、日本、卢森堡、荷兰、新西兰、挪威、波兰、罗马尼亚、西班牙、瑞典、瑞士、前苏联、英国、美国以及西德。“穷国”包括所有其他国家。）

The military investments of the world's states are increasing apace. After the demobilization following World War II, military expenditure has risen dramatically on a per capita basis, especially in the Third World. Between 1960 and 1987, with corrections for inflation, per capita military spending increased by almost 150 percent, while GNP per capita rose about 60 percent (Sivard 1988: 6). In the world's richer countries, however, military budgets actually declined from about 6.9 percent of GNP in 1960 to about 5.5 percent in 1984; in poorer countries, the percentage has risen from 3.6 to 5.6 percent; the poor world is now spending a larger share of its meager income on arms and armies than the rich world spends of its much more ample income. ("Rich countries" include Australia, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Czechoslovakia, Denmark, East Germany, Finland, France, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Luxemburg, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, Rumania, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the former USSR, the United Kingdom, the United States, and West Germany. "Poor countries" include all other states.)

世界各地区在军事支出上的投入程度差异相当大。表7.2提供了细节。就1984年的人均支出而言，世界上支出领先的是北美、华约国家和中东，而就军事支出占国民生产总值的比例而言，中东远远把世界其他地区抛在后面。这场并不光彩的竞赛中的冠军是伊拉克（估计把国民生产总值的38.5%用于军事活动）、阿曼（27.9%）、以色列（24.4%）、沙特阿拉伯（22%）、北也门和南也门（分别为16.9%和15.1%）、叙利亚（14.9%）
以及伊朗（14.6%）；只是到这一点，名单才越出中东，到达安哥拉、苏联、蒙古、利比亚、尼加拉瓜和埃塞俄比亚。李秀勋（Su-Hoon Lee）考察了1960年、1970年和1980年的60个第三世界国家，发现军事支出上升的最强预测因素是：第一，卷入国家间战争；第二，依赖对外贸易（Lee 1988: 95-111）。这一发现凸显了中东国家的脆弱处境——石油与战争在那里交汇。

World regions vary considerably in their devotion to military expenditure. Table 7.2 provides details. In per capita expenditures for 1984, the world's leading spenders were North America, the Warsaw Pact countries and the Middle East, while in proportion of GNP spent on the military the Middle East left the rest of the world far behind. The champions in this dubious contest were Iraq, with an estimated 38.5 percent of GNP devoted to military activity, Oman, with 27.9 percent, Israel, with 24.4 percent, Saudi Arabia, with 22 percent, North and South Yemen, with 16.9 and 15.1 percent, Syria, with 14.9

percent, and Iran, with 14.6 percent; only at that point does the list break out of the Middle East to reach Angola, the USSR, Mongolia, Libya, Nicaragua, and Ethiopia. Examining 60 Third World countries in 1960, 1970, and 1980, Su-Hoon Lee found that the strongest predictors of rising military expenditure were, first, involvement in interstate wars and, second, dependence on foreign trade (Lee 1988: 95-111). The finding underscores the vulnerable positions of Middle Eastern states, where oil and warfare cross.

children: 同样，自1960年以来，在世界各富国，武装力量的人数相当稳定，尽管每名士兵、水兵或飞行员的支出飞涨；而在较穷的国家，1960年以来军队人数大约翻了一番（Sivard 1986: 32）。1960年，世界人口的0.61%在军中服役；到1984年，这一数字略降至0.57%。然而在穷国，这一比例从0.39%上升到0.45%；较富国家的在役军人比例仍然较高，但这些比例在下降，而较穷的国家则在缓慢上升。例如，1964年至1984年间，圭亚那的军事力量（不包括警察）从全体人口的0.1%上升到1.8%（据 Danns 1986: 113-14 计算）；其他地方也发生了类似的扩张，因为前殖民地从撤离的帝国列强留下的简陋治安力量，转向自己规模完备的陆军、民兵和海军。1980年代，中东在军事人口与平民人口的比例上居世界之首，其次是华约国家和北美。单独居首的包括越南（2.1%）、伊朗（2.4%）、叙利亚（2.7%）、伊拉克（3.5%）和以色列（4.3%）；4.3%意味着，按包括妇女、男子和儿童在内的总人口计算，每二十三人中就有一名军人。这样的水平接近17世纪初瑞典的密集军事化。

Similarly, armed forces have remained fairly constant in number throughout the rich parts of the world since 1960 even if expenditure per soldier, sailor or airman has skyrocketed, while in poorer countries troops have roughly doubled in number since 1960 (Sivard 1986: 32). In 1960, 0.61 percent of the world's population served in the military; by 1984, the figure had declined slightly to 0.57. In poor countries, however, the proportion had risen from 0.39 to 0.45; the richer countries still have higher proportions of troops under arms, but those proportions are dropping while the poorer countries creep up. Between 1964 and 1984, for example, Guyana's military forces (excluding police) rose from 0.1 to 1.8 percent of the entire population (calculated from Danns 1986: 113-14); similar expansions occurred elsewhere as former colonies moved from the rudimentary forces of order left by the departing imperial powers to their own full-fledged armies, militias, and navies. In the 1980s, the Middle East led the world in proportion of military to civilian population, followed by the Warsaw Pact countries and North America. The individual champions included Vietnam (2.1 percent), Iran (2.4), Syria (2.7), Iraq (3.5), and Israel (4.3); 4.3 percent meant one person in twenty-three, including women, men, and children. Such a level approached the intense militarization of Sweden in the early seventeenth century.

此外，世界武器流动的格局在过去四分之一世纪里发生了显著变化。出口的绝对数量迅速扩大，从1960年约25亿美元增长到1983年的373亿美元（Sivard 1986: 32）。在大国军事援助的推动下，武器越来越多地流向第三世界。一个原本主要由西方世界一部分运往另一部分的体系，演变为富国向穷国出口的体系。1965年，世界较贫困地区接收了全部国际武器运输的约55%；到1983年，这一比例为77%。（诚然，巴西和以色列当时正开始在世界军火市场上积极竞争，阿根廷也开始建立自己颇具规模的军火工业，但它们都尚未挑战美国、苏联、法国或英国的军售主导地位。）到那时，中东国家每年人均进口价值约106美元的武器，相比之下大洋洲为19美元，北约欧洲为11美元。事实上，中东国家（其中许多可以用石油支付）获得了运往第三世界的全部武器中约一半。

The world pattern of arms flows, moreover, has shifted significantly over the last quarter-century. The sheer volume of exports has expanded rapidly, multiplying from about $2.5 billion in 1960 to $37.3 billion in 1983 (Sivard 1986: 32). Spurred by great power military aid, arms are flowing increasingly to the Third World. From a system in which major shipments of arms went chiefly from one part of the Western world to another has evolved a system in which rich countries export to poor countries. In 1965, the poorer parts of the world were receiving about 55 percent of all international arms shipments; by 1983, the proportion was 77 percent. (True, Brazil and Israel were then beginning to compete actively in the world arms market, and Argentina was beginning to build a serious arms industry of its own, but none of them had yet challenged the arms-sale dominance of the United States, the Soviet Union, France, or Britain.) At that point, Middle Eastern countries were importing some $106 worth of arms per capita each year, as compared with $19 in Oceania, and $11 in NATO Europe. In fact, Middle Eastern states, many of which could pay with oil, were receiving about half of all arms shipped to the Third World.
然而，并非只有中东在购买战争。理查德·坦特（Richard Tanter）对亚洲其余部分作了总结：
Yet the Middle East was not alone in buying war. Richard Tanter sums up for the rest of Asia:

地球上没有其他地方遭受过更严重的组织化暴力之苦：1960年至1982年间全世界因战争相关原因死亡的1070万人中，几乎一半是亚洲人。即使在1975年第二次印度支那战争结束之后，军备仍在流入该地区，其水平与先前一样高，或通常更高。此外，亚洲的军人政府已成为常态而非例外，它们对社会结构的渗透比早先时代更深。从工业化生产国进口到该地区的武器系统，以及数量日益增多的国产精密武器，具有越来越大的破坏能力。（Tanter 1984: 161）

There is no other part of the earth which has experienced greater suffering from organized violence: of the 10.7 million people throughout the world who died from war-related causes between 1960 and 1982, almost half were Asian. Even after the end of the second Indochina war in 1975, armaments are still flowing into the region, and at levels as high as, or usually higher than before. Moreover, military governments in Asia have become the norm rather than the exception, and they have achieved a greater penetration of the social fabric than in earlier times. The weapon systems imported into the region from the industrialized producers and the increasing number of domestically produced sophisticated weapons are of ever greater destructive capability. (Tanter 1984: 161)
1972年至1981年间，在中东以外的所有亚洲国家中，只有缅甸的军事支出（按不变美元计）下降了；朝鲜和韩国、台湾、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、泰国、阿富汗、斯里兰卡和孟加拉国的军事开支（按不变美元计）至少增加了一半。在亚洲和其他地方，军事活动的规模几乎在每一个维度上都在扩大。

Between 1972 and 1981, among all Asian states outside the Middle East, only Burma's military expenditure, in constant dollars, declined; military spending increased by at least half, in constant dollars, in the two Koreas, Taiwan, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, Afghanistan, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. In Asia and elsewhere, the scale of military activity is increasing along almost every dimension.

随着军事机构日益增长，欧洲经验可能使我们预期的那种文官化过程是否仍在继续？有些迹象表明并非如此。假定我们把以下任何一项的存在称为“军人控制”：由军官担任关键政治领导、实施军事管制、安全部队行使法外权力、缺乏对武装力量的中央政治控制，或外国军事力量的占领（Sivard 1986: 24；关于一套更精细、但也更难作经验应用的标准，见 Stepan 1988, 93-127）。所有这些要素全部不存在，即构成对国家的文官控制；当以下任何一项发生时，文官化便发生了：

With growing military establishments, is the process of civilianization that European experience might lead us to expect continuing? We have some indications that it is not. Suppose we call "military control" the presence of any of these: key political leadership by military officers, existence of martial law, extrajudicial authority exercised by security forces, lack of central political control over the armed forces, or occupation by foreign military forces (Sivard 1986: 24; for a more sophisticated set of criteria, but also one that is harder to apply empirically, see Stepan 1988, 93-127). The absence of all of these elements constitutes civilian control of the state; civilianization occurs when any of these happens:
军官担任政治领导的减少；
decline in political leadership by military officers;
军事管制的终结；
end of martial law;
对安全部队法外权力的限制；
curbing of security forces' extrajudicial authority;
对武装力量的集中控制增强；
increase of centralized control over armed forces;
外国军事力量占领的结束。
end of occupation by foreign military forces.

在中东，伊朗、伊拉克、约旦、黎巴嫩、叙利亚和阿拉伯也门共和国符合军人控制的检验标准；在拉丁美洲，有智利、哥伦比亚、萨尔瓦多、危地马拉、海地、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜、巴拿马、巴拉圭；在欧洲，只有土耳其，或许还有波兰。如这些名单所示，标准包括若干严格说来并无军人政府的国家，并且依赖关于武装力量权力与自主性的可争辩判断。例如在危地马拉，一个经选举产生的文官政府自1985年以来名义上一直执政。然而在印第安人聚居地内瓦赫（Nebaj），一位宗教工作者对斯蒂芬·金泽说：“这里有市长，有议员，还有一套法律机构。但军队居于主导地位这一点，从来没有任何疑问。这里任何当选者对任何穿军装的人都没有权威。选举在这里没有影响”（Kinzer 1989: 34）。大多数拉丁美洲的案例都落入这个灰色地带：形式民主，军人权力。不过，如果我们收紧标准，军人国家的趋势和地区分布也不会有实质变化。

In the Middle East, Iran, Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon, Syria and the Arab Republic of Yemen meet the test of military control; in Latin America, Chile, Colombia, El Salvador, Guatemala, Haiti, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama, Paraguay; in Europe, Turkey and perhaps Poland alone. As the lists show, the criteria include a number of states that do not have military government in the strict sense of the term, and rest on debatable judgments about the power and autonomy of the armed forces. In Guatemala, for example, an elected civilian government has nominally ruled since 1985. At the Indian center of Nebaj, however, a religious worker told Stephen Kinzer: "There is a mayor here, there are councilors, and there is a legal apparatus. But there is never any doubt that the army has precedence. No one who is elected here has authority over anyone in uniform. Elections have no impact here" (Kinzer 1989: 34). Most of the Latin American instances fall into this gray zone: formal democracy, military power. If we tightened the standards, however, the trends and regional distributions of military states would not change substantially.

诚然，“军人控制”一词适用于许多不同类型的政体。托马斯·卡拉吉认为，尽管扎伊尔由蒙博托将军领导，却并不处于军人统治之下。他声称，相比于一种正在成为非洲主要类型的“威权的、有机国家主义的行政国家——这种国家大量承袭中央集权与统合主义的殖民传统，由强有力的个人化统治维系在一起，而这种维系往往松散而不稳定”的共同属性，军人国家元首与文官国家元首之间的差异无关紧要（Callaghy 1984: 45）。但他也承认，军人在非洲有攫取权力的特殊机会。他报告说：“然而，这些明显属于早期现代、制度化程度薄弱的军事力量，在早期现代国家与社会的非洲脉络中却
相对
强大”（Callaghy 1984: 44）。因此，在非洲如同在第三世界其他地方，军事扩张似乎促进而非阻止军人统治。这一过程并未像在欧洲那样推进。

The term "military control," to be sure, applies to many different kinds of regimes. Thomas Callaghy denies that Zaïre, despite being led by General Mobutu, lives under military rule. He claims that differences between military and civilian heads of state matter little as compared to the common properties of the "authoritarian, organic-statist administrative state drawing heavily on a centralist and corporatist colonial tradition that is held together, often loosely and in an unstable fashion, by strong personalistic rulership" that is becoming a major African type (Callaghy 1984: 45). Yet he concedes that military men have exceptional opportunities to seize power in Africa. "These distinctly early modern, weakly institutionalized military forces," he reports, "are, however,
relatively

powerful in the African context of early modern states and societies" (Callaghy 1984: 44). Thus in Africa as elsewhere in the Third World military expansion seems to promote rather than deter military rule. The process is not proceeding as it did in Europe.

按我先前设定的标准，1980年代世界上约40%的国家生活在军人控制之下，且这一比例在缓慢上升。各地区之间的差异十分悬殊：在拉丁美洲，全部政府中约38%受军人控制，而这一比例正在下降（在1960年代和1970年代初迅速上升之后）；中东为38%，比1970年代的25%有所上升；南亚稳定在50%，远东在60%上下轻微波动，非洲为64%且在上升。某种形式的军人控制已成为第三世界许多地方的标准政府形式，尤其是在南亚、东亚和非洲。一个地区处于军人控制下的国家比例，与该地区非殖民化的晚近程度相关。许多新近国家自获得或重新获得主权以来，除了军人统治之外所知甚少。截至1990年，加纳人在其独立的30年中有18年生活在军人控制之下，并在此过程中经历了四次重大政变。

By the standards I laid down earlier, about 40 percent of the world's states lived under military control in the 1980s, and the proportion was slowly rising. Variations from region to region were dramatic: in Latin America about 38 percent of all governments are military, and this proportion declining (after a rapid rise in the 1960s and early 1970s); 38 percent in the Middle East, up from 25 percent in the 1970s; a stable 50 percent in South Asia, a mildly fluctuating 60 percent in the Far East, 64 percent and rising in Africa. Military control, of one variety or another, had become the standard form of government in much of the Third World, notably in South Asia, East Asia, and Africa. The proportion of states under military control in a region correlated with the recency of decolonization in that region. Many recent states had known little but military rule since they gained, or regained, their sovereignty. As of 1990 Ghanaians had lived under military control for 18 of their 30 years of independence, and had experienced four major coups in the process.
然而，并非所有军人国家都是新国家。大多数拉丁美洲国家，包括那些由军人治理的国家，自19世纪初以来就作为正式独立的单位存在；事实上，它们比大多数欧洲国家更为古老。再者，古老的泰国提供了军人统治的教科书式案例。

Not all military states, however, are new states. Most Latin American states, including those governed by soldiers, have existed as formally independent units since the early nineteenth century; in fact, they antedate the majority of European states. Again, old Thailand provides a textbook case of military rule.

当时的暹罗在1930年代以其军人政府而引人注目。军方于1932年推翻君主制，此后大部分时间一直掌管国家。1932年至1982年的50年中，军官担任首相达41年；在此期间，暹罗／泰国经历了九次成功政变和另外七次未遂政变；政变与政变图谋过度集中于1945年以后的时期（Chinwanno 1985: 114-15）。在美国的慷慨援助下，泰国军方以反共之名壮大了自己的力量。1972年至1982年间，武装力量从约3万人增加到约23.3万人——扩大到原来的七倍——还不包括估计50万预备役和60万准军事力量（Chinwanno 1985: 115）。军队经营众多农村发展项目，并推动组建准军事团体以打击共产党游击队。

Siam, as it then was called, stood out in the 1930s for its military government. The military overthrew the monarchy in 1932, and have run the state most of the time since then. Of the 50 years from 1932 to 1982, military officers served as prime ministers for 41; during that time Siam/Thailand went through nine successful coups and seven more abortive ones; the coups and coup attempts concentrate disproportionately in the period since 1945 (Chinwanno 1985: 114-15). With generous assistance from the United States, the Thai military have built up their strength in the name of anti-communism. Between 1972 and 1982 the armed forces increased from about 30,000 to about 233,000 - a sevenfold expansion -not including an estimated 500,000 reserves and 600,000 paramilitary forces (Chinwanno 1985: 115). The forces run numerous rural development programs and promote the formation of paramilitary groups to combat Communist guerrillas.
曾几何时，泰国人是不同寻常的。但到如今，许多其他国家已赶上泰国。塔卢克达尔·马尼鲁扎曼（Talukder Maniruzzaman，1987: 221-2）采用与露丝·西瓦德类似的标准，计算了61个第三世界国家在1946年至1984年间全部独立年份中处于军人政府之下的比例。居前者如下：

Once the Thais were unusual. But by now, many other states have caught up with Thailand. Using criteria similar to Ruth Sivard's, Talukder Maniruzzaman (1987: 221-2) has calculated for 61 Third World states the proportion of all years of independence between 1946 and 1984 during which they had military government. The leaders run as follows:
**80—100%：**中国／台湾、泰国、萨尔瓦多、尼加拉瓜、阿尔及利亚、埃及、扎伊尔、布隆迪、叙利亚
80-100 percent:
China/Taiwan, Thailand, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Algeria, Egypt, Zaïre, Burundi, Syria
