Paraguay, Sudan, Upper Volta, Argentina, Benin, Central African Republic, Togo, Equatorial Guinea, Guatemala, Iraq, People's Republic of Congo, Mali, Burma, Republic of Korea, Brazil, Somalia, Bangladesh, Yemen Arab Republic
**40—59%：**尼日利亚、巴基斯坦、秘鲁、加纳、印度尼西亚、格林纳达、洪都拉斯、马达加斯加、玻利维亚、巴拿马、多米尼加共和国、利比亚、柬埔寨、苏里南、尼日尔
马尼鲁扎曼省略了海地这类案例：杜瓦利埃家族不仅自取军衔，还动用国家军队和私人武装恐吓平民人口；因此他低估了军人控制的普遍程度。平均而言，第三世界国家自1946年以来的独立岁月，有一半以上处于军人掌控之下。
40-59 percent:
Nigeria, Pakistan, Peru, Ghana, Indonesia, Grenada, Honduras, Madagascar, Bolivia, Panama, Dominican Republic, Libya, Kampuchea, Suriname, Niger

Maniruzzaman has omitted such cases as Haiti, where the Duvalier family not only assumed military titles but also used public and private armies to terrorize the civilian population; he therefore underestimates the prevalence of military control. The average Third World state has spent more than half its years of independence since 1946 in the hands of soldiers.
随着军人控制的上升，第三世界政变的频率也上升了。图7.2传达了主要信息：1940年代世界上每年发生八到十起军事政变尝试（约一半成功），到1970年代增加到这一数字的大约一倍，成功率相近。与内战不同，政变通常在没有外部列强明显介入的情况下发生。在这四十年间，外国列强介入促成了全部政变尝试中约7%，并阻止了另外4%（David 1987: 1-2）。这些数字当然意味着，世界上近90%的政变是在
没有
实质外国干预的情况下发生的。

As military control rose, the frequency of coups d'etat rose in the Third World. Figure 7.2 conveys the main messages: an increase from eight or ten attempted military coups, about half of them successful, somewhere in the world during the 1940s to about double the number, and similar success rates, during the 1970s. Unlike civil wars, coups usually occurred without manifest involvement of outside powers. Over the forty years, foreign powers intervened to promote about 7 percent of all coup attempts, and to deter another 4 percent (David 1987: 1-2). The figures mean, of course, that almost 90 percent of the world's coups occurred
without
substantial foreign intervention.

政变增多，部分原因是独立国家增多。图7.3逐年把政变尝试与成功政变的数目同联合国会员国数目相比较，表明在1960年代众多亚洲和非洲国家加入之前的按国家平均频率高于之后。图7.4至图7.6具体说明了当时的情况：在拉丁美洲、中东和亚洲，直到1964年前后，政变在平均每三个国家每年一起上下剧烈摆动，此后稳定为每五个或十个国家每年一起。然而在非洲，按每个国家计算的政变频率，在欧洲仍实行殖民控制的时期完全为零，此后却上升，
自1959年起超过了第三世界其他地区。然而，这并不意味着政变频率的上升是统计上的幻象。恰恰相反：这意味着1960年以后进入联合国的国家格外易受军事政变之害。

Coups multiplied in part because independent states multiplied. Figure 7.3, which compares the numbers of attempted and successful coups to the number of UN members year by year, shows that the per-state frequencies ran higher before the entry of numerous Asian and African states in the 1960s than afterward. Figures 7.4 to 7.6 specify what was happening: in Latin America, the Middle East, and Asia, coups swung wildly around an average of one each year for every three states until about 1964, then settled down to one each year per five or ten states after that. In Africa, however, coups rose in frequency from none whatsoever during the period of continued European control to higher

frequencies of coups per state than elsewhere in the Third World from 1959 onward. This does not mean, however, that the rising frequency of coups is a statistical mirage. On the contrary: it means that the states entering the United Nations after 1960 were disproportionately vulnerable to military coups.

Unsurprisingly, the geography of coups corresponds to the geography of military rule. From 1980 through 1987, the world's coup attempts occurred in Spain, North Yemen, South Yemen, Egypt, Bahrein, Syria, Lebanon, Libya, Bangladesh, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, North Korea, Bolivia, Suriname, Argentina, Haiti, Guatemala, Panama, Grenada, Sudan, Mauritania, Equatorial Guinea, Liberia, Gambia, Central African Republic, Seychelles, Ghana, Zimbabwe, Chad, Somalia, Kenya, Upper Volta, Tanzania, Togo, Swaziland, Cameroons, Niger, Lesotho, Nigeria, Guinea-Bissau, the Comores, Guinea, and Uganda; military insurgents actually seized power in South Yemen, Bangladesh, the Philippines, Argentina, Suriname, Guatemala, Bolivia, Grenada, Panama, Haiti, Central African Republic, Ghana, Chad, Upper Volta, Nigeria, and Guinea - a disproportionate concentration of coups, and especially of attempts, in Africa.

1980年以后政变尝试与成功政变数的明显下降是否代表一种确定的变化，仍有待观察。迄今为止，第二次世界大战以来各种变化的净效应，是或多或少由军人直接控制的世界独立国家份额的大幅增加。马尼鲁扎曼的统计表明，1946年至1981年的每个时段内，从军人统治回归文官统治的次数都少于军事政变，而在1982—1984年间二者各为六次，达到平衡。在拉丁美洲，国家转向文官控制的变化似乎紧随始于1960年代的军事政变频率下降（后者本身是相对稳定的军人政体建立的结果）。第二次世界大战以来拉丁美洲经历了三个阶段：国家权力的持续斗争期，导致军事化的净增长（1945年至1960年代初）；相对稳定的军人统治期（1960年代至1970年代末）；以及军事权力部分削减的时期（1980年以来）。鉴于拉丁美洲一再有人过早宣布文官化，我们无法确信1980年以来的逆转会持续下去（Rouquié 1987: 2-3）。无论如何，亚洲、非洲和中东的国家似乎已进入更稳定的军人统治形式；迄今为止，政变频率的下降并未表明已从军人控制中解放出来。

Whether the apparent fall-off in attempts and successes after 1980 represents a definitive change still remains to be seen. So far the net effect of changes since World War II has been a massive increase in the share of the world's independent states controlled more or less directly by military men. Maniruzzaman's counts show that returns from military to civilian rule were fewer than military coups in every interval from 1946 to 1981, and that they balanced at six each in 1982-4. In Latin America, a shift to civilian control of states seems to be following the decline in the frequency of military coups (itself the result of the installation of relatively stable military regimes) that began in the 1960s. Latin America has gone through three stages since World War II: a period of constant struggles for state power, resulting in a net increase in militarization (1945 to early 1960s); a period of relatively stable military rule (1960s to late 1970s); and a period of partial reduction in military power (since 1980). Given repeated premature announcements of civilianization in Latin America, we can have no confidence that the reversal since 1980 will continue (Rouquié 1987: 2-3). States in Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, in any case, appear to have settled into more stable forms of military rule; so far the decline in coup frequencies does not bespeak liberation from military control.
那么，第三世界国家自第二次世界大战以来已大规模军事化；除拉丁美洲外，我们没有强有力的迹象表明这一趋势正在逆转、文官化过程正在开始。若是如此，世界就有值得担忧之处：不仅因为这意味着我们关于民族国家会随经验而“成熟”的旧观念是错的，不仅因为第三世界的战争会涉及核武器或导致大国对峙的风险，还因为军人控制与国家对公民的暴力携手并进。

Third World states have, then, militarized extensively since World War II; with the exception of Latin America, we have no strong signs that the trend is reversing, and a process of civilianization setting in. If so, the world has something to worry about: not only because it means our old ideas about the "maturing" of national states with experience are wrong, not only because of the risk that a war in the Third World will involve nuclear arms or lead to a great power confrontation, but also because military control and state violence against citizens go hand in hand.

看看以酷刑、暴行、绑架和政治杀戮形式出现的官方对公民的暴力。按露丝·西瓦德的评级，在整个第三世界，军人控制的国家中有一半“经常”对其公民使用暴力，而非军人国家中只有五分之一这样做。拉丁美洲、中东和远东的差异比南亚和非洲更大。同样，对选举权的限制在军人统治的第三世界国家中比在非军人国家中明显更为常见。此外，这种关系看起来像是因果关系：当军人获得权力时，公民权利与人权便衰退。任何重视政治代表制、重视保护公民免受国家权力滥用的人，都应当担忧世界范围的军事化。

Consider official violence against citizens, in the form of torture, brutality, kidnappings, and political killings. In the Third World as a whole, according to Ruth Sivard's ratings, half of all military-controlled states "frequently" employed violence against their citizens, while only a fifth of non-military states did so. The differences are stronger in Latin America, the Middle East, and the Far East than in South Asia and Africa. Similarly, restrictions on the right to vote are significantly more common in military than in non-military Third World states. The relationship, furthermore, looks like cause and effect: when the military gain power, civil and human rights fail. Anyone who values political representation and the protection of citizens against abuses of state power should worry about world-wide militarization.

en: HOW DID THE MILITARY GAIN POWER?

children: 如果在欧洲国家体系经历了数百年的文官化之后，新近加入该体系的国家正走向军人统治，那么这种转变该如何解释？让我们说清楚：鉴于第三世界国家的多样性，没有任何单一解释能详细说明每个国家军事权力的兴起。对于撒哈拉以南非洲，塞缪尔·德卡洛否认军队的实力与内聚性同它们争夺国家权力的强烈倾向有任何关系；他反而主张，“许多非洲军队［由］一些彼此分立的武装营垒［构成］，它们主要通过庇护—依附关系效忠于少数军官；这些军官级别不一、相互竞争，心中充满种种团体、族群和个人的怨愤”（Decalo 1976: 14-15），内部竞争驱使他们企图发动政变；而麦克斯韦·奥乌苏（1989）把加纳独立后的政变纳入反抗不配其位的酋长的民粹主义叛乱的悠久传统之中。然而，露丝·科利尔指出，非洲军方在以下国家更常夺取权力：某一派系把一党统治强加于其他派系的国家，或在独立时出现代表多个族群的多党制的国家，而不是在独立前一党优势通过选举胜利成长起来的国家（Collier 1982: 95-117）。多重庇护—依附链条与族群分裂的共存，显然使非洲国家易受军事权力的侵袭，但这一过程受全国性联盟与政党所设定的限制。

If, after centuries of civilianization in the European state system, the states that have joined the system recently are moving toward military rule, what might explain the shift? Let us be clear: given the variety of Third World states, no single explanation will account in detail for the rise of military power in each country. For sub-Saharan Africa, Samuel Decalo denies that the strength and coherence of the military has anything to do with their great propensity to bid for national power; on the contrary, he argues, "many African armies [consist of] a coterie of distinct armed camps owing primarily clientelistic allegiance to a handful of mutually competitive officers of different ranks seething with a variety of corporate, ethnic and personal grievances" (Decalo 1976: 14-15), with internal competition driving them to attempt coups, while Maxwell Owusu (1989) inserts Ghana's post-independence coups in a long tradition of populist rebellions against unworthy chiefs. Ruth Collier points out, however, that the African military seized power more often in states where one faction imposed one-party rule on others, or a multi-party system representing numerous ethnicities appeared at independence than where one-party dominance grew up through electoral successes prior to independence (Collier 1982: 95-117). The coexistence of multiple patron-client chains and ethnic fragmentation apparently makes African states vulnerable to military power, but within the limits set by national coalitions and parties.
无论如何，这种解释在南亚大部分地区、拉丁美洲和中东说服力较弱。关于拉丁美洲，J. 塞缪尔·菲奇说：
In any case, such an explanation holds less weight in much of South Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East. Concerning Latin America, according to J. Samuel Fitch:
关于军事政变的前提条件，已形成日益增长的共识。当军官们认为存在危机局势时，政变就会发生。公众骚乱和敌视政府的舆论、对军队机构性利益的威胁、文官总统违反宪法、现任政府明显无力处理严重经济危机，或重大的“共产主义威胁”，都会增强军方的危机感。个人野心和个人关系可能影响个别军官，但发动军事政变的决定一般是一种机构性决定，反映了整个武装力量上层对政府表现的集体评估。（Fitch 1986: 27-8）

A growing consensus has emerged regarding the preconditions for military coups. Coups occur when military officers believe a crisis situation exists. Public disorders and public opinion hostile to the government, threats to the military's institutional interests, violations of the constitution by civilian presidents, evident inability of the incumbent administration to manage a serious economic crisis, or a significant "Communist threat" will increase the military's sense of crisis. Personal ambitions and personal ties may influence individual officers, but the decision to stage a military coup is generally an institutional decision, reflecting the collective evaluation of government performance within the upper ranks of the armed forces as a whole. (Fitch 1986: 27-8)
那么，在世界尺度上，我们只能期望先识别那些使军事权力更容易或更可能出现的条件，然后再转向各国和各地区的具体历史，考察通向军事霸权的确切路径。有三种主要的可能。

On a world scale, then, we can only hope to identify conditions that made military power easier or more probable before turning to the particular histories of states and regions for the examination of precise paths to military hegemony. Three main possibilities come to mind.
**第一，**文官主导的制度在第三世界可能失败得如此频繁，以致军方在权力真空中接掌政权。二十五年前，注意到军队对第三世界文官政治干预增加的西方政治分析者倾向于这种解释。
First,

civilian-dominated institutions might be failing with sufficient frequency in the Third World that the military take over by default. Twenty-five years ago, Western political analysts who noticed the increased intervention of armies in Third World civilian politics leaned toward that explanation.
**第二，**外部列强给予第三世界军事组织的不成比例的支持，可能使这些组织相对于其国内竞争者获得额外实力。对美国军事援助计划的激进批评者常常表述这种解释。
Second,

the disproportionate support that outside powers give to Third World military organizations might be lending those organizations extra strength vis-à-vis their competitors within their own states. Radical critics of American military assistance programs often articulate that explanation.
**第三，**在西方广泛发生的对军队的谈判与遏制过程可能并未发生，因为国家以商品或政治上的从属为代价，从本国之外的大国获取军事手段。或者这三种情况可能同时发生。
Third,

the process of negotiation and containment of the military that occurred widely in the West may not be occurring, because states acquire their military means from great powers outside the state, in return for commodities or political subordination. Or all three could be happening at once.
我们缺乏可靠证据判断三者之中哪一种正在发生。对1960年至1982年间35个非洲国家内部军事干预政治的细致分析表明，以下因素促进了干预：

We lack reliable evidence on which of the three is occurring. A careful analysis of military intervention in politics within 35 African states between 1960 and 1982 indicates that these factors promoted intervention:
军队受单一族性集团支配；
domination of the army by a single ethnic group;
高额军事支出与对政府反对者的频繁制裁相结合；
high military expenditure combined with frequent sanctions against government opponents;
政治多元主义的缺失；
absence of political pluralism;
独立前选举投票率低；
low electoral turnout before independence;
农业人口比例低；
low proportion of the population in agriculture;
首都人口迅速增长；
rapid increase in the population of the capital city;
工业就业与国民生产总值增长缓慢；
slow increase in industrial jobs and in GNP;
出口占国民生产总值的比例低；
low proportion of exports to GNP;
商品出口日益单一化。（Johnson, Slater and McGowan 1984: 635）
decreasingly diversified commodity exports. (Johnson, Slater and McGowan 1984: 635)

尽管这类统计式的因果探究大多带有杂驳的性质，这份清单仍回响着若干反复出现的主题。它尤其把军事自主与经济危机的结合描绘为有利于军事介入。作者们自己得出结论说，“社会动员”有利于军事干预，而“政治参与”则起阻碍作用。他们评论说：“看来，在有影响力者已内化资本主义世界经济的规则、从而相对较好地应对了过去十年极其严酷的国际经济环境的那些国家，这些国家在一定程度上减轻了自身的边缘性，某种程度上加强了文官结构，所经历的军事干预主义也少于有影响力者应对不那么好的国家”（Johnson, Slater and McGowan 1984: 636）。尽管这些因素每一项都值得单独讨论，但它们中没有一个能对国家何以或多或少易受军事接管的历史过程提供多少说明。

Despite the miscellaneous character that infects many such statistical searches for causes, the list sounds some recurrent themes. More than anything else, it portrays a combination of military autonomy and economic crisis as favorable to military involvement. The authors themselves conclude that "social mobilization" favors military intervention and "political participation" works against it. "It would appear," they remark, "that in states where influentials have internalized the rules of the capitalist world economy and thereby coped relatively well with the very harsh international economic environment of the last 10 years, these states have lessened their peripherality to a degree, strengthened their civilian structures somewhat, and experienced less military interventionism than states whose influentials have not coped as well" (Johnson, Slater and McGowan 1984: 636). Although each of these factors deserves discussion in its own right, none of them sheds much light on the historical process by which states become more or less vulnerable to military takeovers.

让我们说清楚。国家内部具有特征性的分裂在世界各地区之间根本不同，而雄心勃勃的军人与平民人口中各集团之间的实际联盟也相应不同。族性裂隙在当代非洲和南亚国家极为重要，但在当代拉丁美洲国家内部则远不那么重要。宗教分歧——伊斯兰内部与外部的——进入了中东大多数重大冲突。此外，在军人统治已占主导的地方，武装力量内部的竞争常常产生夺取国家权力的企图。阿根廷1987年4月15日及其后的未遂政变，代表了军队中一部分人对在前一个军事独裁下侵犯人权行为受起诉的抵制（Bigo et al. 1988: 56-7）；斐济1987年5月14日的政变发生，“明确是为了保护斐济原住民群体的特殊利益”，以对抗该群岛人口接近半数的印度裔群体的选举力量（Kelly 1988: 399）；布隆迪1987年9月3日的政变则使军队中一个派系与另一派系相互对立（Bigo et al. 1988: 65）。在这个层次上，每一个军人政权和每一次军事夺取国家权力的尝试都取决于当地社会结构和以往历史。然而，如果我们离开特定历史就无法解释特定军人政权的历程，我们仍可以合理地问：1945年以来某些世界范围的变化是否使军方的权力争夺在全世界更为可行、更具吸引力，从而有助于解释军人政权的世界范围增加。

Let us be clear. Characteristic schisms within states vary fundamentally from one world region to another, and the actual alliances between ambitious military men and groups within the civilian population vary accordingly. Ethnic cleavages matter a great deal in contemporary African and South Asian states, but much less so within contemporary Latin American states. Religious divisions, within and outside Islam, enter most major conflicts in the Middle East. Where military rule already prevails, furthermore, competition within the armed forces themselves frequently produces bids for state power. Argentina's attempted coup of 15 April 1987 and thereafter represented one segment of the army's resistance to prosecution for human rights violations under the preceding military dictatorship (Bigo et al. 1988: 56-7), Fiji's coup of 14 May 1987 occurred "expressly to protect the special interests of Fiji's indigenous Fijian community" against the electoral power of the islands' Indian near-majority (Kelly 1988: 399), and Burundi's coup of 3 September 1987 pitted one army faction against another (Bigo et al. 1988: 65). At this level, every military regime and every attempted military seizure of state power depends on local social structure and previous history. If we can't explain the courses of particular military regimes without particular histories, however, we can still reasonably ask whether some world-wide changes since 1945 have made military bids for power more feasible and attractive throughout the world, and therefore help explain the world-wide increase in military regimes.
迄今为止，我们并不知道这三种假设性过程——文官制度的失败、对军队的外部支持、国家与公民之间谈判的最小化——中是否有任何一种真的在当代世界发生。我们应当去查明。但第三世界国家近期经历与使欧洲文官化的那些条件之间的对比，提示了一个关于非洲、中东和亚洲大部分地区
可能
正在发生什么的重要推测。这一推测是：第二次世界大战以来一个两极的、随后初显三极的世界国家体系的形成，加剧了大国之间争夺第三世界国家效忠的竞争，以及不让第三世界任何部分保持中立的倾向。这种竞争促使大国、尤其是美国和苏联向许多国家提供武器、军事训练和军事建议。

So far we don't know if any of the three hypothetical processes - failure of civilian institutions, external support for the military, minimization of negotiations between state and citizens - is really occurring in the contemporary world. We should be finding out. But contrasts between the recent experiences of Third World states and the conditions that civilianized Europe suggest an important speculation about what
might

be happening in Africa, the Middle East, and much of Asia. Here is the speculation: the creation of a bipolar, then incipiently tripolar world system of states since World War II intensified the competition among great powers for the allegiance of Third World states, and the tendency to leave no part of the Third World neutral. That competition induced the great powers, especially the United States and the Soviet Union, to provide arms, military training, and military advice to many states.

作为回报，大国或大国境内的主要利益集团获得了石油之类的商品、世界舞台上的政治支持，有时还有军售利润。在那些国家，军事组织在规模、实力和效能上增长，而其他组织停滞或萎缩。军事组织相对的生存能力使其对雄心勃勃却囊中羞涩的年轻人具有吸引力，于是军队把人才从商业、教育和文官公共行政中吸引走。军方因此越来越容易夺取对国家的控制，而文官统治者越来越难以遏制他们。某种形式的普力夺主义（军人干政，pretorianism）——用塞缪尔·亨廷顿的标签，即寡头式的、激进式的或大众式的——出现了。军事化占了上风。

In return, the great powers, or major interests within them, received commodities such as oil, political support in the world arena and, sometimes, profits from the sale of arms. In those states, military organizations grew in size, strength, and efficacy while other organizations stood still or withered. The relative viability of military organizations made them attractive to ambitious but impecunious young men, so the military diverted talent from business, education, and civilian public administration. The military thus found it easier and easier to seize control of the state, and civilian rulers found it more and more difficult to check them. One form or another of pretorianism -oligarchical, radical, or mass, to use Samuel Huntington's labels - emerged. Militarization prevailed.

这一推测可信吗？对那些我们有详细战后政治史的国家而言，其经验为之提供了一些支持。极端案例包括台湾以及朝鲜和韩国，在那里，外国列强对当地军队的大规模支持产生了对国民经济的钢铁般控制，直到经济扩张的巨大成功本身开始侵蚀军事霸权（Amsden 1985, Cumings 1984, 1988, Deyo, Haggard and Koo 1987, Hamilton 1986）。例如在韩国，日本占领军的前军官朴正熙于1961年夺取权力。朴正熙刻意着手建立日本式的“富国强兵”（Launius 1985: 2）。他之所以能够这样做，主要有两个原因：一是朝鲜从1907年到1945年作为受严密控制的日本殖民地而存在，其朝鲜官员轻易地进入了新政权内的权力位置；二是美国占领军——它今天仍留在韩国——支持这一计划，并参与了对反对的工人和学生的遏制。

Is the speculation credible? The experience of countries for which we have detailed postwar political histories give it some support. Extreme cases include Taiwan and the two Koreas, where the massive support of foreign powers for the local military produced steely control of the national economies, until the very success of economic expansion began to undermine military hegemony (Amsden 1985, Cumings 1984, 1988, Deyo, Haggard and Koo 1987, Hamilton 1986). In South Korea, for example, Park Chung-Hee, a former officer in the Japanese occupation army, seized power in 1961. Park deliberately set out to establish a Japanese-style "rich country and powerful military" (Launius 1985: 2). He was able to do so for two main reasons: because Korea had lived from 1907 to 1945 as a tightly-controlled Japanese colony, whose Korean officials had easily moved into positions of power within the new regime, and because the American occupying army - which remains in Korea today - backed the plan, and participated in the containment of opposing workers and students.

1950年夏北朝鲜占领韩国时发生的革命性土地再分配，清除了地主这一可能反对军事霸权的另一来源（Cumings 1989: 12）。尽管韩国在美国主持下经历了几段短暂的名义民主时期，1961年的政变毕竟使军方牢牢掌握了权力。在军人控制与美国支持之下，韩国建立了一个低工资、出口导向的经济，尤其面向日本和美国市场。苏联以类似方式，尽管经济成效较小，长期在德意志民主共和国、匈牙利和捷克斯洛伐克等卫星国维持军事存在与监督。

The revolutionary redistribution of land that occurred when North Korea occupied South Korea during the summer of 1950 had liquidated landlords as another possible source of opposition to military hegemony (Cumings 1989: 12). Although South Korea has gone through several brief periods of nominal democracy under American auspices, the 1961 coup d'etat put the military definitely in the saddle. Under military control and American sponsorship, South Korea built a low-wage, export-oriented economy aimed especially at Japanese and American markets. In similar ways, although with less economic success, the Soviet Union long maintained a military presence and supervision in such satellites as the German Democratic Republic, Hungary, and Czechoslovakia.

也许除了巴拿马、古巴和洪都拉斯之外，在拉丁美洲，外国对国家军队、从而对国家的直接控制并未达到东亚的极端程度。自近两个世纪前挣脱西班牙和葡萄牙而独立以来，拉丁美洲国家一直维持着自己强有力的军事干预政治传统。然而，持久的政治政体在1960年代和1970年代变得更加普遍。它们采取两种颇为不同的形式：巴拉圭的斯特罗斯纳或尼加拉瓜的索摩查那种个人化的庇护主义统治，以及在庇隆之后的阿根廷和瓦加斯之后的巴西盛行的军方“制度性”控制。

Except possibly for Panama, Cuba, and Honduras, direct foreign control of the national military, and thus of the state, does not approach East Asian extremes in Latin America. Latin American states have sustained their own strong tradition of military intervention in politics since they wrenched themselves independent of Spain and Portugal almost two centuries ago. Durable political regimes, however, became more prevalent during the 1960s and 1970s. They took two rather different forms: the personalistic, clientelistic rule of a Stroessner in Paraguay or a Somoza in Nicaragua, and the "institutional" control by the military that prevailed in post-Peron Argentina and post-Vargas Brazil.

在1960年代之前的相当长一段时间里，美国把许多加勒比和中美洲国家置于“军事监护”之下，随意派遣美国海军陆战队去维持或恢复它所偏好的政体（Rouquié 1987: 117-28）。然而，直到那时，无论美国资本还是美国军事援助都未深入扩展到拉丁美洲其余部分。极为频繁的南美洲政变很少招致美国的直接干预。随着古巴革命和初起的苏古合作，肯尼迪政府开始重新界定其拉丁美洲政策；从1962年开始，美国军事援助
变得比以往更密集、更制度化。美国的军事规划变得更有结构，拉丁美洲各国军队与宗主国军队之间的关系变得更加紧密。美国陆军在这个次大陆的19个国家设有重要性不等的军事使团，它们的存在往往是出售或出借军事装备协议的组成部分（Rouquié 1987: 132）。

For some time before the 1960s the United States had held many Caribbean and Central American states in "military tutelage," feeling free to send the US Marines to maintain or restore regimes it preferred (Rouquié 1987: 117-28). Up to that point, however, neither American capital nor American military aid extended very deeply into the rest of Latin America. The very frequent South American coups d'etat attracted little direct US intervention. With the Cuban revolution and incipient Soviet-Cuban cooperation, the Kennedy administration began to redefine its Latin American policy; beginning in 1962, American military aid

became more intensive and better institutionalized than before. American military planning became more structured and the relations between the Latin American armies and that of the metropole grew closer. The U.S. Army had military missions of varying importance in nineteen countries of the subcontinent and their presence was often an integral part of the agreements for the sale or loan of military equipment. (Rouquié 1987: 132)
美国对拉丁美洲的军事援助从1953—1963年间每年约4000万美元上升到1964—1967年间每年约1.25亿美元（Rouquié 1987: 131）。这种存在通过加强那些已掌握权力的军人政权，帮助减少了拉丁美洲军事夺取权力的频率。直到1970年代末美国开始撤回对当地军队的支持时，才出现了一个微弱的文官化趋势。

American military aid to Latin America rose from about $40 million per year in 1953-63 to about $125 million per year in 1964-7 (Rouquié 1987: 131). That presence helped reduce the frequency of military seizures of power in Latin America by reinforcing those military regimes that already held power. Not until the end of the 1970s, when the United States began to withdraw its support for resident militaries, did a minor trend toward civilianization set in.

巴西是一个显而易见的例证。尽管自1889年军队推翻巴西帝国以来军方一直盘旋于文官政治之上，但直到1964年的“四月革命”，它才夺取对国家直接的、持久的控制。此后，军人主导的政权向美国资本、美国军事援助以及冷战中的巴美合作开放了巴西。军人控制持续到1985年。在1982年的地区选举中，反对派领导人取得了关键的省级州长职位；1984年，温和的军人权力反对者坦克雷多·内维斯赢得巴西总统职位。去军事化开始，但军方获得了重大的补偿性收益：不断扩张的国内军火工业，以及国家军事预算的增加。美国并未直接干预巴西的文官化，但它对人权日益增加的关切，以及越来越不愿支持势力衰退的军方的态度，无疑帮助铺平了道路。

Brazil is an obvious case in point. Although the military had hovered over civilian politics from the army's overthrow of the Brazilian Empire in 1889, it did not seize direct, durable control over the state until the "April Revolution" of 1964. But then military-dominated regimes opened Brazil to American capital, American military aid, and Brazilian-American cooperation in the Cold War. Military control continued to 1985. In 1982 regional elections, opposition leaders took key provincial governorships, and in 1984 a moderate opponent of military power, Tancredo Neves, won the Brazilian presidency. Demilitarization began, but with significant compensating gains for the military: an expanding domestic arms industry, and an increase in the national military budget. The United States did not intervene directly in Brazilian civilianization, but its increased concern for human rights and its decreased readiness to prop up declining militaries surely helped set the stage.

邻国苏里南在脱离荷兰独立后五年内就走向军人统治，但其士兵自称社会主义者（Sedoc-Dahlberg 1986）。从1975年独立到1980年军事政变，苏里南的三个主要政党代表其占主导地位的族性群体：印度斯坦人、克里奥尔人和爪哇人。但在军队内部一系列劳资纠纷之后，一支由中士们率领的600人部队夺取了国家控制权，新政府开始从古巴获得大量援助，并使其政治与古巴保持一致。与此同时，军方扩充了人数，组织了一支约3000人的“人民民兵”用于内部控制，并使全体人口中约1.4%的人处于武装之下，超过低收入国家世界平均水平的三倍。巴西领导人因侧翼出现一个左翼国家而警觉，于1983年开始作出安排，据此“苏里南将向巴西出售大米和氧化铝，以换取足以让苏里南军队规模翻倍的武器运输”（Sedoc-Dahlberg 1986: 97），而苏里南也将缓和其社会政策。来自古巴和巴西的援助相结合，增加了军方在苏里南内部的回旋余地，使他们能够在没有广泛社会基础的情况下统治。

Neighboring Suriname arrived at military rule within five years of its independence from the Netherlands, but its soldiers declared themselves socialists (Sedoc-Dahlberg 1986). From independence in 1975 to the military coup of 1980, Suriname's three major political parties represented its dominant ethnic groups: Hindustani, Creole, and Javanese. But when a force of 600 troops led by sergeants seized control of the state after a series of labor disputes within the army, the new government began receiving substantial aid from Cuba, and aligning its politics with Cuba's. At the same time the military expanded their numbers, organizing a People's Militia of some 3,000 troops for internal control, and maintaining about 1.4 percent of the entire population under arms, more than three times the world average for low-income states. Brazilian leaders, alarmed by the presence of a leftist state on their flank, began an arrangement in 1983 by which "Suriname would sell rice and alumina to Brazil in exchange for arms shipments sufficient to allow Suriname's army to double in size," (Sedoc-Dahlberg 1986: 97), and Suriname would also moderate its social policies. The combination of aid from Cuba and Brazil served to increase the military's room for maneuver within Suriname, allowing them to rule without a broad social base.

利比亚走上通往军人统治的另一条道路（Anderson 1986: 251-69）。意大利帝国主义把两个彼此敌对而迥然相异的地区——的黎波里塔尼亚和昔兰尼加——合为一块领土。塞努西领袖伊德里斯在1951年独立时成为国王，其主要支持来自昔兰尼加；他在盟军驱逐意大利出北非的努力中的合作，使他相对于的黎波里塔尼亚的对手获得了决定性的政治优势。独立的利比亚并未出现一个界定清晰的民族国家。取而代之的是，相互重叠的扩大家庭通过庇护关系进行统治。石油收入使他们致富，使建设一些基础设施成为可能，并使国王及其地方属僚无需建立庞大的中央官僚机构就能统治。小小的利比亚王家军队由第二次世界大战中与英国人并肩作战的部队组成，但同从部落人口中征召的地方安全部队以及美英军事基地相比，却相形见绌。尽管有英美存在，上尉穆阿迈尔·卡扎菲于1969年领导了一次成功的政变。的确，对石油收入的控制使卡扎菲得以驱逐英国人和美国人，清除大多数旧统治者，使国家伊斯兰化和阿拉伯化，着手实施一项援助其他地方新生革命政权的计划，同时又继续其前任对庞大中央结构的回避。转型后的国家小心翼翼地开始与苏联结交，并展开一场反对美国权力的运动。于是，某种民族主义支撑了一个脆弱的国家，并为军人统治提供了正当性。

Libya followed yet another path to military rule (Anderson 1986: 251-69). Italian imperialism made a single territory of hostile and distinctly different Tripolitania and Cyrenaica. Sanusi leader Idris, who became king at independence in 1951, drew support chiefly from Cyrenaica; his cooperation in the Allied effort to oust Italy from North Africa gave him a decisive political advantage over his Tripolitanian rivals. No well-defined national state emerged in independent Libya. Instead, overlapping extended families governed through patronage. Oil revenues enriched them, allowed the construction of a measure of infrastructure, and permitted the king and his satraps to rule without building a substantial central bureaucracy. The small Royal Libyan Army formed from units that had fought with the British in World War II, but were overshadowed by provincial security forces drawn from tribal populations and by the presence of American and British military bases. Despite the Anglo-American presence, captain Mu'ammar al-Qadhdhafi led a successful coup d'etat in 1969. Indeed, control over oil revenues made it possible for Qadhdhafi to expel the British and Americans, root out most of the old rulers, Islamize and Arabize the state, undertake a program of assistance to nascent revolutionary regimes elsewhere, and yet to continue his predecessor's avoidance of bulky central structure. The transformed state gingerly began a courtship with the Soviet Union and a campaign of opposition to American power. A kind of nationalism, then, bolstered a fragile state and justified military rule.

在韩国，美国占领直接塑造了战后国家。在巴西，美国对拉丁美洲军队态度的变化制约了政治转变，但绝非支配了军事权力的历史。利比亚尽管有美国军事存在，仍走向军人政权。军事权力的条件与后果显然在第三世界各地区之间差异极大。大国竞争与干预在任何特定政变中、在任何特定军人政权的维持中，只起配角作用。但第三世界国家与大国之间以及彼此之间关系的变动，似乎对世界整体军事控制总节律的变化有重要贡献。就此而言，国家体系本身起了作用。

In South Korea, an American occupation directly shaped the postwar state. In Brazil, changing American orientations toward Latin American militaries conditioned political shifts but by no means governed the history of military power. Libya moved to a military regime despite an American military presence. Conditions and consequences of military power obviously vary significantly from one part of the Third World to another. Great power competition and intervention play no more than supporting parts in any particular coup and in the maintenance of any particular military regime. But alterations in relations of Third World states to great powers and to each other seem to have contributed importantly to changes in the overall rhythms of military control in the world as a whole. To that extent, the state system as such has made a difference.

如果大国对峙与对国家军队的干预具有本分析赋予它的那种影响，那么通向文官化的一条路径看来是清楚的。它有两条分支：要么减少大国之间增强第三世界国家军事实力的竞争，要么使目标国家与那种竞争相隔绝。它涉及促进国家文官机构与大多数公民之间的讨价还价。建立征课有常、行政公平并能回应公民的税收制度，很可能加快这一进程。提供可替代从军的可行职业道路也会如此。正如阿尔弗雷德·斯捷潘（1988: 84-5）所主张的，巴西建立庞大的军火出口产业，可能产生降低其将军们自主性的悖论性效果，从而通过文官官僚机构、既得利益和与平民人口的讨价还价的积累，加快某种民主化的进程；更一般地说（人们或许希望，也更少好战地），政府越来越多地参与不断扩大的商品与服务生产，很可能促进文官化。这绝不是重演欧洲经验；如今，想必我们能够避开那种经验中的某些残酷。但这毕竟是一组机会，而对欧洲国家形成的清醒反思使它们稍微不那么晦涩。

If great power confrontation and intervention in national militaries has the influence this analysis gives it, one path toward civilianization seems clear. It has two branches: either a reduction in the great power competition to build up the military strength of the Third World states or an insulation of the target states from that competition. It involves the promotion of bargaining between the state's civilian institutions and the bulk of its citizens. The creation of regular systems of taxation, equitably administered and responsive to the citizenry, would probably speed the process. So would the opening of viable career alternatives to military service. It is possible, as Alfred Stepan (1988: 84-5) argues, that Brazil's mounting of a major arms export industry will have the paradoxical effect of reducing the autonomy of its generals, and thus speeding a kind of democracy through the accretion of civilian bureaucracies, vested interests, and bargains with the civilian population; more generally (and, one might hope, less belligerently), the growth of government involvement in expanding production of goods and services is likely to promote civilianization. Not by any means a recapitulation of the European experience; these days, presumably, we can escape some of the cruelty of that experience. But yet a set of opportunities that a sober reflection on European state formation makes a bit less obscure.

诚然，我对这些主题的处理带有特殊的弦外之音。尽管我先前作了种种声明，它仍回到一种知识殖民主义的形式，回到这样一种假定：如果欧洲国家以自己的方式走向了公共生活的文官化，那么今天的第三世界国家也能并且也应当如此——只要它们或它们的庇护者愿意让欧洲的进程展开。它忽略了各地区之间地缘政治的差异，而这些差异对军民关系影响巨大：美国在中美洲或加勒比直接军事干预的持续威胁、石油对许多中东经济的中心地位、南非对其北方各国的广泛渗透、日本、韩国和台湾的工业扩张作为邻国政治中的一个因素。它忘记了族性碎裂与冲突对军事权力的推动。我试图把当代军事化置于历史视野之中，却有风险把光束照得如此之亮，以致实际上模糊了对象的细微之处，抹掉了它实际的明暗格局。我的辩护很简单：我们需要意识到，第三世界国家军事权力的兴起并非国家形成的一个自然阶段，并非先前经验告诉我们会随着国家成熟而逐渐过去的东西。

To be sure, my treatment of these themes has peculiar overtones. It returns, despite all my earlier protestations, to a form of intellectual colonialism, to the presumption that if European states worked their ways to civilianization of public life, so could and should today's Third World states - if only they or their patrons would let the European process unfold. It neglects the geopolitical variation among regions that makes such a difference to military-civil relations: the constant threat of direct American military intervention in Central America or the Caribbean, the centrality of oil to many Middle Eastern economies, the wide reach of South Africa within the states to its north, the industrial expansion of Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan as a factor in the politics of their neighbors. It forgets ethnic fragmentation and strife as promoters of military power. My attempt to place contemporary militarization in historical perspective runs the risk of shining so bright a beam that it actually obscures its subject's subtleties, wipes out its actual pattern of light and shade. My defense is simple: we need to be aware that the rise of military power in Third World states is not simply a natural phase of state formation, one that previous experience tells us will pass gradually as states mature.

无论如何，当代军事化并不是欧洲国家形成研究能提供启示的唯一重要主题。这一过程本身就值得关注，仅仅因为欧洲民族国家体系的形成深刻影响了所有西方人、也影响了大多数非西方人的生活。我希望本书已表明，欧洲国家形成、乃至民族国家对其他政治组织形式的最终胜利，具有极大的偶然性。只有16世纪国际战争在规模与费用上的巨大扩张（诚然，这既是欧洲国家之间竞争的结果，也是它们与土耳其人和中国人互动的结果），才使民族国家相对于此前在欧洲盛行的帝国、城邦和联邦获得了决定性的优势。

In any case, contemporary militarization is not the only important subject on which the study of European state formation sheds light. The process deserves attention for its own sake, simply because the formation of a European system of national states profoundly affected the lives of all Westerners, and of most non-Westerners as well. This book has, I hope, shown the great contingency of European state formation, indeed of the national state's ultimate triumph over other forms of political organization. Only the great sixteenth-century expansion in the scale and expense of international wars (which was, to be sure, an outcome of rivalries among European states as well as their interaction with Turks and Chinese) gave national states a definitive advantage over the empires, city-states, and federations that prevailed in Europe up to that time.

欧洲人也并未遵循单一的道路通向民族国家。由于大陆不同地区集中资本与集中强制的相对优势不同，三种部分有别的转型模式——强制密集型、资本密集型与资本化强制——为统治者、地主、资本家、工人和农民同样标出了深刻不同的经历。在这一过程中，大多数曾经存在的国家消失了，其余的国家则在形式与行动上经历了根本变化。在资本家占上风的地区和时期，国家往往碎裂化、抵制中央集权，并给代表其统治阶级的正式机构留出很大空间。在18世纪和19世纪庞大的公民军队增长之前，这类国家很容易为战争（尤其是海战）进行动员，但它们在此过程中建立的持久国家结构相对很少。

Nor did Europeans follow a single path to the national state. As a function of the relative predominance of concentrated capital and concentrated coercion in different parts of the continent, three partly distinct patterns of transformation - coercion-intensive, capital-intensive, and capitalized-coercion - marked out deeply different experiences for rulers, landlords, capitalists, workers, and peasants alike. Along the way, most states that once existed disappeared, and the rest underwent fundamental changes in form and action. In regions and periods where capitalists held the upper hand, states commonly fragmented, resisted centralization, and gave a large scope to formal institutions representing their dominant classes. Before the eighteenth- and nineteenth-century growth of huge citizen armies, such states mobilized easily for warfare (especially naval warfare), yet created relatively little durable state structure as they did so.
相比之下，地主主导的地区更常产生庞大的中央集权国家，因为仅仅是从非商业化经济中榨取战争资源的努力，就创造了广泛的行政机构和统治者与其拥有地产的盟友之间影响深远的协约。在极端情形下，如波兰在四五个世纪中的情况，地主势力压倒了王权，促成了停滞或崩溃。

Landlord-dominated regions, in contrast, more often produced bulky, centralized states as the sheer effort of squeezing the means of war from uncommercialized economies created extensive administrations and far-reaching compacts between rulers and their landed allies. At the extreme, as in the case of Poland over four or five centuries, the weight of landlords swamped royal power and promoted immobility or collapse.

在资本密集型与强制密集型国家形成道路之间，资本与强制较为均衡的搭配保证了阶级斗争，但在法国和英国等少数案例中，它为形成一个有能力创造并维持庞大武装力量的民族国家开辟了道路。这少数幸存者为所有其他国家设定了战争的标准，在把欧洲国家体系以及欧洲式民族国家强加于世界其余部分的过程中发挥了不成比例的作用。第二次世界大战以来，这个曾经属于欧洲的民族国家体系已声称控制整个地球。由于该体系起源于欧洲，对欧洲历史的细致考察有助于我们理解当代世界体系的起源、特征与局限。

In between the capital-intensive and coercion-intensive paths of state formation, a more even balance of capital and coercion guaranteed class struggle, but in a few cases such as France and Great Britain opened the way to formation of a national state having the capacity to create and sustain massive armed force. Those few survivors set the standard of war for all other states, playing disproportionate parts in the imposition of the European state system, and the European variety of national state, on the rest of the world. Since World War II, the once-European system of national states has claimed control over the entire earth. Because the system originated in Europe, the close examination of European history helps us understand the origins, character, and limits of the contemporary world system.

这就更有理由细察那些在我1992年春季写作时正把欧洲国家迅速推入新时代的变化。不可思议的事情已经发生。自1988年以来，苏联先是从其在阿富汗与美国那场深刻却间接的对峙中撤出军队，随后碎裂为若干组成共和国，其中一些又开始轮到自己碎裂。俄罗斯和乌克兰（如今是一个摇摇欲坠的联邦内各自独立的国家）因核武器、克里米亚和黑海舰队的归属而彼此发出战争叫嚣。南斯拉夫分裂为塞尔维亚和半圈相继脱离的非塞尔维亚共和国。德意志民主共和国消融于其更大、更富的德国邻居兼昔日敌人之中。其他东欧和中欧国家在程度不等的斗争之后否弃了其社会主义政权，而最近去社会主义化的捷克斯洛伐克，其捷克部分与斯洛伐克部分之间也出现了裂隙。在前苏联势力范围的若干国家内，军人统治的前景上升了。

All the more reason to scrutinize changes that are rushing European states into a new era as I write in the spring of 1992. The inconceivable has happened. Since 1988, the Soviet Union has first withdrawn its military from its deep, if indirect, confrontation with the United States in Afghanistan, then splintered into its component republics, some of which have begun to splinter in their turn. Russia and Ukraine (now separate states within a shaky federation) have made warlike noises at each other over possession of nuclear weapons, the Crimea, and the Black Sea fleet. Yugoslavia has split into Serbia and a semicircle of fleeing non-Serbian republics. The German Democratic Republic has dissolved into its larger, richer, German neighbor and erstwhile enemy. Other east and central European states have repudiated their socialist regimes after varying degrees of struggle, and fissures have opened up between Czech and Slovak segments of recently desocialized Czechoslovakia. The prospects for military rule have risen in a number of states within the former Soviet zone of influence.

这还不是全部。在行将瓦解的苏联首肯下，美国率领若干欧洲国家，为回应伊拉克入侵科威特而对伊拉克发动了一场毁灭性的攻击。与此同时，欧洲共同体向经济统一又迈进了几步，相邻国家——包括若干不久前还实行社会主义的国家——开始热切地争相以某种形式加入欧共体。就范围、速度和相互依存而言，这些转变类似于通常源于先前大战安排的欧洲国家体系的重大变动，如1815—1818年、1918—1921年或1945—1948年。仿佛冷战不止是一个隐喻。

That is not all. With the dying Soviet Union's blessing, the United States has led a number of European states into a devastating attack on Iraq in response to Iraq's invasion of Kuwait. Meanwhile, the European Community has moved several steps closer to economic unification, as adjacent states - including a number of recently socialist states - have begun to compete eagerly for some form of inclusion in the EC. In scope, rapidity, and interdependence, these shifts resemble the momentous alterations in the European state system that have typically stemmed from the settlements of previous general wars, as in 1815-18, 1918-21, or 1945-8. It is as if the Cold War was more than a metaphor.

这些变化之间究竟有没有联系？如果有，又是如何联系的？毫无疑问，核心的联系把三种结构连接起来：美国国家、苏联国家和欧洲共同体。在经济基础严重不平等的情况下，四十年来美国人和苏联人都把其外交政策围绕彼此的军事与政治竞争来组织。双方在阿富汗的干预（美国方面通过支持反对苏联所支持政权的游击反对派，苏联方面通过财政援助和直接军事介入）已经表明，美国有能力阻止苏联的胜利——即使不能建立一个亲美政权——同时消耗苏联的财力、人力，削弱其士气和军事威望。

How, if at all, do these changes connect? No doubt the central nexus joins three structures: the American state, the Soviet state, and the European Community. On grossly unequal economic bases, Americans and Soviets had for forty years organized their foreign policies around military and political competition with each other. The two sides' interventions in Afghanistan (the Americans' through support of guerrilla oppositions to the Soviet-backed regime, the Soviets' through financial aid and direct military involvement) had demonstrated the American capacity to block a Soviet victory, if not to install a pro-American regime, while draining Soviet finances, manpower, morale, and military prestige.

米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫1985年上台，不仅开始组织从阿富汗撤军。他还进一步把苏联的去军事化扩展为一般政策：停止对华约区域内异见运动的强力镇压，并把苏联经济从军事生产转向民用生产。尽管这些政策深深威胁到苏联的军方、情报机构和党内权力机构，却使加入欧洲共同体对前苏联集团的大多数部分而言既可想象又具吸引力。与此同时，这些政策迅速而明显地削弱了苏联在波兰、捷克斯洛伐克、爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚、立陶宛以及苏联西部边界沿线其他地区的合作者的权威。当戈尔巴乔夫对该区域卫星国政权的挑战者不予军事干预时，反对派迅速动员起来。

Coming to power in 1985, Mikhail Gorbachev not only started to organize withdrawal from Afghanistan. He extended the Soviet Union's demilitarization, furthermore, to general policies of ceasing forceful repression against dissident movements within the Warsaw Pact zone as well as of shifting the Soviet economy from military toward civilian production. Although the policies deeply threatened the Soviet Union's military, intelligence, and party establishments, they made access to the European Community both thinkable and attractive to most segments of the former Soviet bloc. At the same time, they rapidly and visibly weakened the authority of Soviet collaborators in Poland, Czechoslovakia, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, and other regions along the USSR's western frontier. When Gorbachev refrained from military intervention against challengers to its satellite regimes in that zone, oppositions mobilized quickly.
在另一些国家，以及在最先脱离者一走便会被撇下的那些国家的下属单位中，自治或独立的要求成倍增加。苏联境内各组成共和国和与之相连的族性群体的领导人有效地向外部国家呼吁，援引民族自决的神奇原则。于是爱沙尼亚、立陶宛和拉脱维亚迅速从仍然存在的苏联脱身。后来斯洛文尼亚、克罗地亚和波斯尼亚—黑塞哥维那也为其脱离南斯拉夫获得了类似的支持。

Demands for autonomy or independence multiplied in other states and subdivisions of states the first departures would otherwise leave behind. Leaders of both constituent republics and connected ethnic groups within the USSR appealed effectively to outside states, citing the magic principle of national self-determination. Thus Estonia, Lithuania, and Latvia escaped quickly from the still-extant Soviet Union. Later Slovenia, Croatia, and Bosnia-Herzegovina gained similar support for their exits from Yugoslavia.

在他摇摇欲坠的祖国，戈尔巴乔夫面临的反对不仅来自他正在削弱的军方、情报机构和党内权力机构，还来自另外两个关键的群体。第一个群体包含苏联各行政区划——格鲁吉亚、奥塞梯、摩尔达维亚、纳戈尔诺—卡拉巴赫，甚至列宁格勒——中彼此竞争的民族主义者和伪民族主义者集团。第二个群体包括一个松散的经济与政治改革者网络，他们最终聚集在前莫斯科党组织领导人鲍里斯·叶利钦周围。民意调查的大量涌现，以及为新设立的人民代表大会举行有竞争的选举，给了改革者鼓舞，使他们相互联结起来。1991年8月，旧机构成员发动的一场未遂政变，因军队倒戈和包括叶利钦在内的改革者的协同反对而失败；然而在那场政变之后，戈尔巴乔夫离任，叶利钦作为俄罗斯联邦的首脑成为实际的全国领袖，苏联分裂为名义上结为邦联的若干共和国，而
波罗的海诸国则彻底离去。不仅冷战结束了，它的一个超级大国也已化为尘土。

Within his own shaken country, Gorbachev faced opposition not only from the military, intelligence, and party establishments he was undermining, but also from two other crucial clusters. The first contained competing groups of nationalists and pseudonationalists in the USSR's various administrative subdivisions - Georgia, Ossetia, Moldavia, Nagorno-Karabakh, even Leningrad. The second included a loose network of economic and political reformers who eventually grouped around Boris Yeltsin, the former Moscow party boss. The proliferation of opinion surveys and the holding of contested elections for a newly-created Congress of People's Deputies gave the reformers comfort and connection. In August 1991 an attempted coup by members of the old establishments lost to military defections and concerted opposition by reformers including Yeltsin; in the wake of that coup, however, Gorbachev left office, Yeltsin became effective national leader as chief of the Russian federation, the USSR broke into nominally confederated republics, and the
Baltic states departed definitively. Not only was the Cold War over, one of its superpowers had crumbled into dust.
从较长时期看，如果本章的推理成立，冷战敌意的消退应当减轻以下压力：使非欧洲国家与某个大国集团结盟；以武器换取商品和政治忠诚；建立或维持军人政权；以及干预全世界的内战。它还应当加速欧洲人在家产制、经纪和国家化时代所创造、随后在19世纪和20世纪强加于几乎整个世界的国家体系的解体。若果真如此，世界就有一个无与伦比的和平重建的机会。

In the longer run, if this chapter's reasoning runs true, the decline of Cold War hostilities should reduce the pressure to align non-European countries with a great power bloc, to arm them in exchange for commodities and political loyalty, to establish or maintain military regimes, and to intervene in civil wars throughout the world. It should also accelerate the dissolution of the state system Europeans created during the ages of patrimonialism, brokerage, and nationalization, then imposed on almost the entire world during the 19th and 20th centuries. If so, the world has an unparalleled opportunity for peaceful reconstruction.

这个体系还能持续多久？我们看到一些迹象表明，形式上自治国家的时代正在过去：联合国的僵局；持久军事—经济集团取代迅速变动的联盟；欧洲经济共同体和欧洲自由贸易联盟等市场联结集合体的形成；资本的国际化；资本遍布各地却又不属任何一地的公司兴起；现有国家内部对自治和民族地位的要求，这些要求最终可能把它们缩减为昔日蛋糕的碎屑；美国和苏联向内部事务的转向；前苏联境内各民族的政治动员；一个本质上去军事化的国家——日本——取得重大的世界权力；中国将把其巨大的组织、人口和意识形态力量扩展到世界其余部分这一前景或威胁。欧洲人所塑造的国家体系并非一直存在。它也不会永存。

How long will the system last? We see some signs that the era of formally autonomous states is passing: the stalemate of the United Nations, the displacement of rapidly shifting alliances by durable military-economic blocs, the formation of market-linked ensembles such as the EEC and EFTA, the internationalization of capital, the rise of corporations whose capital is everywhere and nowhere, demands for autonomy and nationality within existing states that could eventually reduce them to crumbs of the former cake, the shift toward internal concerns by the United States and the Soviet Union, the activation of nationalities within the former USSR, the achievement of substantial world power by an essentially demilitarized state - Japan - the promise or threat that China will extend its enormous organizational, demographic, and ideological power into the rest of the world. The state system Europeans fashioned has not always existed. It will not endure forever.

它的讣告将很难写。一方面，我们看到欧洲社会生活的平靖，以及多少具有代表性的政治制度的塑造，二者都是受追求军事强力驱动的国家形成的副产品。另一方面，我们注意到战争破坏性的上升、国家对个人生活的无处不在的干预、无可比拟的阶级控制工具的创造。摧毁国家，就制造出黎巴嫩。强化国家，就制造出韩国。在其他形式取代民族国家之前，两种选择都不行。唯一真正的答案，是把民族国家的巨大力量从战争转向创造正义、人身安全与民主。我的探究并未表明如何完成这一艰巨任务。但它已表明这一任务为何紧迫。

Its obituary will be hard to write. On one side, we see the pacification of European civil life and the fashioning of more or less representative political institutions, both by-products of a state formation driven by the pursuit of military might. On the other side, we notice the rising destructiveness of war, the pervasive intervention of states in individual lives, the creation of incomparable instruments of class control. Destroy the state, and create Lebanon. Fortify it, and create Korea. Until other forms displace the national state, neither alternative will do. The only real answer is to turn the immense power of national states away from war and toward the creation of justice, personal security, and democracy. My inquiry has not shown how to accomplish that gigantic task. It has, however, shown why the task is urgent.

zh: 本稿用“民族国家”译 national state，指以集权、分化而自主的结构治理多个相邻地区及其城市的国家；用“国民国家”译 nation-state，指其人民共享强烈的语言、宗教和象征认同的国家。这是作者有意作出的概念区分，二者不可互换。此处引文用的是后者。
